entries.en:
History of the Augur, Part I

We, the families of the Augur, have been living here for many generations. In the course of time, we acquired certain insights in the ways of our masters, the Yalahari. Many years ago, things used to be very different in this city. Once it was a marvel to behold, but then it started to decay slowly and steadily. This process of deterioration begun in the far past, long before our ancestors came[ here. At the time they were brought here by the Yalahari as helpers and workers, the city already showed signs of decline. Despite their claim of having great power, the Yalahari could do little to stop the catastrophes that should occur. Neither did they do anything to restore the damaged parts of the city. Still, it took many centuries until the city had reached the pitiful state that you can witness today.

Some decades ago, a group of Augur suspected that we all were lied to by our masters. They started to look for clues that proved their assumptions, and secretly gathered parts of the puzzle one by one. For all we know, there had been indeed a powerful race called the Yalahari that built this city to distance itself from the wars of some capricious gods. So far the tales that our masters had told us, have been true. These Yalahari were served by a group of Augur such as us. They were their helpers and workers, and the Yalahari shared some of their luxuries and achievements with them. The Yalahari concentrated on research and art, and left the more manual work to their servants, who often only knew what they had to do without understanding their tasks. At one far-away point in history, the Yalahari seemingly vanished. Certain clues that our ancestors gathered, hint that they locked themselves in the city's centre and cut off all contact to their helpers. When the Augur sometime later dared to enter the inner city, the Yalahari were all gone - vanished without a trace. After getting over the initial shock, the Augur assumed the role of the Yalahari themselves. For a while they tried to get familiar with some of the secrets of their lost masters, but they were only able to understand the most basic concepts of the Yalahari's knowledge. They stuck to their usual tasks to keep the city running. Still, they were too few to keep the enormous city, of which they understood so little, in shape.

So they decided to recruit Augur on their own. This way most of our forefathers came to Yalahar. In the meanwhile, the former Augur retreated into the inner city.
entries.translated:
Historia del Augur, Parte I

Nosotros, las familias de los Augur, hemos vivido aquí durante muchas generaciones. Con el paso del tiempo, adquirimos ciertos conocimientos sobre las costumbres de nuestros maestros, los Yalahari. Hace muchos años las cosas eran muy diferentes en esta ciudad. Una vez fue una maravilla de contemplar, pero luego comenzó a decaer lenta y constantemente. Este proceso de deterioro comenzó en un pasado lejano, mucho antes de que nuestros antepasados ​​vinieran aquí. Cuando los Yalahari los trajeron aquí como ayudantes y trabajadores, la ciudad ya mostraba signos de decadencia. A pesar de su pretensión de tener un gran poder, los Yalahari poco pudieron hacer para detener las catástrofes que deberían ocurrir. Tampoco hicieron nada para restaurar las partes dañadas de la ciudad. Aún así, pasaron muchos siglos hasta que la ciudad alcanzó el lamentable estado que puedes presenciar hoy.

Hace algunas décadas, un grupo de Augur sospechaba que nuestros amos nos mintieron a todos. Comenzaron a buscar pistas que probaran sus suposiciones y en secreto reunieron las piezas del rompecabezas, una por una. Por lo que sabemos, efectivamente hubo una raza poderosa llamada Yalahari que construyó esta ciudad para distanciarse de las guerras de algunos dioses caprichosos. Hasta ahora los cuentos que nos habían contado nuestros maestros, han sido ciertos. Estos Yalahari fueron atendidos por un grupo de Augur como nosotros. Eran sus ayudantes y trabajadores, y los Yalahari compartían con ellos algunos de sus lujos y logros. Los Yalahari se concentraban en la investigación y el arte, y dejaban el trabajo más manual a sus sirvientes, quienes a menudo sólo sabían lo que tenían que hacer sin comprender sus tareas. En un momento lejano de la historia, los Yalahari aparentemente desaparecieron. Ciertas pistas que nuestros antepasados ​​reunieron, insinúan que se encerraron en el centro de la ciudad y cortaron todo contacto con sus ayudantes. Cuando el Augur, algún tiempo después, se atrevió a entrar en el centro de la ciudad, los Yalahari ya no estaban, desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. Tras superar el shock inicial, el Augur asumió el papel de los propios Yalahari. Durante un tiempo intentaron familiarizarse con algunos de los secretos de sus maestros perdidos, pero sólo pudieron comprender los conceptos más básicos del conocimiento de los Yalahari. Se apegaron a sus tareas habituales para mantener la ciudad en funcionamiento. Aún así, eran demasiado pocos para mantener en forma la enorme ciudad, de la que entendían tan poco.

Entonces decidieron reclutar a Augur por su cuenta. De esta manera la mayoría de nuestros antepasados ​​llegaron a Yalahar. Mientras tanto, el antiguo Augur se retiró al centro de la ciudad.

entries.en:
History of the Augur, Part II

They brought more and more people to Yalahar. Not all of them became Augur, a good part of them lived in Yalahar as ordinary citizens. At some point, the city had reached a much larger population than under the rule of the true Yalahari, and it became difficult to provide food and shelter for everyone. Time and overuse took it's toll on the city. Over the years, more and more parts of the city were lost due to ignorance, lack of resources, or catastrophes. The new Yalahari were unable to restore broken machines and devices, and their efforts to retake certain parts of the city with the help of the Augur caused only more disaster. So the new Yalahari decided to stay in the city's centre, letting the Augur care for the rest of the city as well as they could. Still, their image as Yalahari allowed them to claim supremacy and to rule over the whole city. This all did not matter too much to our ancestors. The new Yalahari were neither cruel nor overly abusive, and they still wielded the powerful weapons and armors of the true Yalahari. So they stuck to the status quo and continued to work for the Yalahari despite everything they had found out. This worked quite well although the city was still declining and great parts of it had been lost to chaos and anarchy.

Lately, though, things started to change. It is not a dramatic change but it can be recognised gradually at many places. Some of the known routines in the orders of the Yalahari have altered. There are more and more orders who have a dubious purpose. The most frightening thing is that some orders obviously hint at a person with Yalahari knowledge that had been considered as lost for centuries. The overwhelming majority of the new Yalahari still clings to their ignorant and self-centred ways, but perhaps one of them or a small group has discovered some hidden secrets of their vanished masters. It is also possible that something completely different is happening, we simply don't know. But these new orders that seem to aim at restoring order in the city have some bitter taste. They are somewhat oppressive and destructive, not in an obvious way, though. Taken together, they paint a dark picture of Yalahar's future. A future of oppression, betrayal, and a much stricter rule by the Yalahari.
entries.translated:
Historia del Augur, Parte II

Trajeron cada vez más gente a Yalahar. No todos se convirtieron en Augur, buena parte de ellos vivían en Yalahar como ciudadanos comunes y corrientes. En algún momento, la ciudad había alcanzado una población mucho mayor que bajo el gobierno del verdadero Yalahari, y se volvió difícil proporcionar comida y refugio para todos. El tiempo y el uso excesivo pasaron factura a la ciudad. Con el paso de los años, cada vez más partes de la ciudad se fueron perdiendo por desconocimiento, falta de recursos o catástrofes. Los nuevos Yalahari no pudieron restaurar máquinas y dispositivos averiados, y sus esfuerzos por recuperar ciertas partes de la ciudad con la ayuda del Augur sólo causaron más desastre. Así que el nuevo Yalahari decidió quedarse en el centro de la ciudad, dejando que los Augur se ocuparan del resto de la ciudad lo mejor que pudieran. Aun así, su imagen de Yalahari les permitió reclamar supremacía y gobernar toda la ciudad. Todo esto no les importaba demasiado a nuestros antepasados. Los nuevos Yalahari no eran ni crueles ni demasiado abusivos, y todavía empuñaban las poderosas armas y armaduras del verdadero Yalahari. Así que se apegaron al status quo y continuaron trabajando para Yalahari a pesar de todo lo que habían descubierto. Esto funcionó bastante bien, aunque la ciudad todavía estaba en decadencia y gran parte de ella se había perdido en el caos y la anarquía.

Sin embargo, últimamente las cosas empezaron a cambiar. No es un cambio dramático pero se puede reconocer gradualmente en muchos lugares. Algunas de las rutinas conocidas en las órdenes del Yalahari han cambiado. Cada vez hay más pedidos que tienen una finalidad dudosa. Lo más aterrador es que algunas órdenes obviamente insinúan a una persona con conocimientos de Yalahari que se habían considerado perdidos durante siglos. La abrumadora mayoría de los nuevos Yalahari todavía se aferra a sus costumbres ignorantes y egocéntricas, pero tal vez uno de ellos o un pequeño grupo haya descubierto algunos secretos ocultos de sus desaparecidos maestros. También es posible que esté sucediendo algo completamente diferente, simplemente no lo sabemos. Pero estas nuevas órdenes que parecen encaminadas a restablecer el orden en la ciudad tienen un sabor amargo. Son algo opresivos y destructivos, aunque no de manera obvia. En conjunto, pintan un panorama oscuro del futuro de Yalahar. Un futuro de opresión, traición y un gobierno mucho más estricto por parte de los Yalahari.

entries.en:
Manifest of the Yalahari, Part I

The city has been neglected for far too long. We concentrated on our research and spiritual evolution and have turned a blind eye on the needs of the people that are our subjects. We have too strongly relied on the help of the Augur who in turn did little but the same routines for many generations. We have decided it is time to take initiative. The experiment to give people too much freedom and too little guidance has to be stopped before all is lost. We have a responsibility for this city and the people living here. Only with our help, they will be able to flourish and to overcome the shadows of the past. The city can be rebuilt and restored to at least some of its former glory when we diligently work for it. It will be hard and it will take the help of determined individuals to assist us in our efforts. However, in the long run, order will be completely re-established and Yalahar will once again be the magnificent city it used to be.

Only with drastic decisions and changes, this great goal can be achieved. We will have to get through hard times and prepare for them as good as we can. Most importantly, a good city needs a solid base. For this reason we have to start at the bottom to clean things up. We have to be precise and consequent in our decisions and actions. This way we will be able to create a solid base for the city.

To some extent, we have to work like a gardener. The rotten parts have to be cut off, and the healthy parts have to be cherished. The city has to be retaken. Then order can be restored and the actual rebuilding can begin. In the end, the city will once again be a centre of prosperity and a shining light in a dark world.
entries.translated:
Manifiesto del Yalahari, Parte I

La ciudad lleva demasiado tiempo abandonada. Nos concentramos en nuestra investigación y evolución espiritual y hemos hecho la vista gorda ante las necesidades de las personas que son nuestros súbditos. Hemos confiado demasiado en la ayuda del Augur, quien a su vez hizo poco más que las mismas rutinas durante muchas generaciones. Hemos decidido que es hora de tomar la iniciativa. Hay que detener el experimento de dar a la gente demasiada libertad y muy poca orientación antes de que todo esté perdido. Tenemos una responsabilidad con esta ciudad y la gente que vive aquí. Sólo con nuestra ayuda podrán florecer y superar las sombras del pasado. La ciudad puede ser reconstruida y restaurada para recuperar al menos parte de su antigua gloria si trabajamos diligentemente por ella. Será difícil y será necesaria la ayuda de personas decididas que nos ayuden en nuestros esfuerzos. Sin embargo, a la larga, el orden se restablecerá por completo y Yalahar volverá a ser la magnífica ciudad que solía ser.

Sólo con decisiones y cambios drásticos se podrá lograr este gran objetivo. Tendremos que superar tiempos difíciles y prepararnos para ellos lo mejor que podamos. Lo más importante es que una buena ciudad necesita una base sólida. Por esta razón tenemos que empezar desde abajo para limpiar las cosas. Tenemos que ser precisos y consecuentes en nuestras decisiones y acciones. De esta manera podremos crear una base sólida para la ciudad.

Hasta cierto punto tenemos que trabajar como jardineros. Hay que cortar las partes podridas y cuidar las partes sanas. Hay que retomar la ciudad. Entonces podrá restablecerse el orden y podrá comenzar la reconstrucción propiamente dicha. Al final, la ciudad volverá a ser un centro de prosperidad y una luz brillante en un mundo oscuro.

entries.en:
Manifest of the Yalahari, Part II

It is obvious that such greatness comes not without sacrifices, but we will make sure to keep them to a minimum. All of our decisions serve a greater good, of course. Even if this is not always obvious, in the end things will work out and provide us all with a better life and a bright future.

Based on the ruins of our former glory, it is hard to imagine how magnificent this future will be, but we, the Yalahari, still carry the vision of what we want to accomplish in our hearts. To bring this vision to life is our greatest goal which we all work towards.

There are elements that see their power and influence waning in these days of change. They are afraid of the things to come, and in their ignorance they cling to the rotting reality they know all too well. They created their own little niches of power and influence and feel guilty for neglecting their duties, and with that also for the decay of the city. They are surely already approaching unsuspecting outsiders to poison their minds with selfish lies. For generations the Augur, once the pride of our people, have done things the same way they had known for generations, and everyone can see where it has taken Yalahar.
entries.translated:
Manifiesto del Yalahari, Parte II

Es obvio que tal grandeza no se logra sin sacrificios, pero nos aseguraremos de mantenerlos al mínimo. Todas nuestras decisiones sirven a un bien mayor, por supuesto. Aunque esto no siempre sea obvio, al final las cosas saldrán bien y nos brindarán a todos una vida mejor y un futuro brillante.

Teniendo en cuenta las ruinas de nuestra antigua gloria, es difícil imaginar cuán magnífico será este futuro, pero nosotros, los Yalahari, todavía llevamos la visión de lo que queremos lograr en nuestros corazones. Dar vida a esta visión es nuestro mayor objetivo por el que todos trabajamos.

Hay elementos que ven menguar su poder e influencia en estos días de cambio. Tienen miedo de lo que está por venir y, en su ignorancia, se aferran a la podrida realidad que conocen muy bien. Crearon sus propios pequeños nichos de poder e influencia y se sienten culpables por descuidar sus deberes y, con ello, también por la decadencia de la ciudad. Seguramente ya se están acercando a extraños desprevenidos para envenenar sus mentes con mentiras egoístas. Durante generaciones, los Augur, que alguna vez fueron el orgullo de nuestro pueblo, han hecho las cosas de la misma manera que lo habían sabido durante generaciones, y todos pueden ver adónde ha llevado a Yalahar.

entries.en:
"Still it is hard to believe that I finally
found the mystical rock formations near
Darashia, known as Lion's Rock.
According to ancient records there is a
temple for an unknown, probably long
forgotten deity, built in the tunnels deep
below the rock centuries ago. This holy
site was once guarded by mystical lions
and they may still be down there. But
yet I haven't succeeded in entering the
inner sanctum. The entrance to the
lower temple areas is protected by an
old and powerful enchantment. I
studied the inscriptions on the temple
walls and thus learned that the key to

entries.en:
This page seems to be part of a book about ancient rituals, mystic incantations and far away places. Besides a very prominent symbol, embedded in the text, a spell can be deciphered from the strange script:

~ As daylight fades, mix chalk or bone meal with your own blood and water ~
~ Draw with it a circle in the middle of the room ~
~ Stand in this sphere when drawing the symbol "Of Night And Day Intersecting Ostensum Est"
~ Utter all of the following words loudly with clear voice: CERTAGIA SALABANTHR DANNHE GENT'HO" ~
~ Looking upward, repeat the incatation and you shall teleport the periphery of your body ~
entries.translated:
Esta página parece ser parte de un libro sobre rituales antiguos, encantamientos místicos y lugares lejanos. Además de un símbolo muy destacado, incrustado en el texto, se puede descifrar un hechizo de la extraña escritura:

~ A medida que la luz del día se desvanece, mezcle tiza o harina de huesos con su propia sangre y agua ~
~ Dibuja con él un círculo en el medio de la habitación ~
~ Párese en esta esfera cuando dibuje el símbolo "De la noche y el día intersectando Ostensum Est"
~ Pronuncie todas las siguientes palabras en voz alta y clara: CERTAGIA SALABANTHR DANNHE GENT'HO" ~
~ Mirando hacia arriba, repite la incatación y te teletransportarás a la periferia de tu cuerpo ~

entries.en:
Tunnelling guide
----------------
by Gromward Hammerfist

'The art of building a tunnel lies in the nature of dwarfes.' That's what my grand grand grandfather used to say. First of all I'd like to give you a small historical review of tunnelling. .....<you skip the first 1000 pages containing dwarfen tunnelling history>.

Repairing collapsed tunnels:
Equipment: Pick, tree or bricklayers kit
Before picking away the rubble you need to place a buttress otherwise the tunnel will collapse over and over again. If you don't have a matching tree at hand you could still build a brickwall to stabilize the tunnel. Good luck!

Repairing gaps:
Equipment: Wood, wooden ties, hammer, nails, metal fitting
For each missing part (on the basis of a standard rail) I recommend to use three pieces of wood. Lock them in position by at least 6 nails. For the rail itself use a saw on a piece of wood to build your wooden ties. Then place two metal fittings on them and you can make your first ride on your new rail. Congratulations!

Building a rail on lava:
I advice not to try that until you have at least 20 years experience in rail construction......<Well, seems like you don't match the premises.>

Adventuring old tunnels:
Be aware that our kind mastered the art of tunnelling. It may take you a whole life to understand the techniques that are used and it takes generations to know all the tunnels of a mine and all their exits. You even may find an exit that you never expected to.

To sum up
If you are no dwarf don't even try to think that you have a chance of mastering the art of tunnelling. If you are a dwarf I wish you good luck and don't abandon faith. There is a light at the end of the tunnel.

Yours

Gromward Hammerfist
entries.translated:
guía de túneles
----------------
por Gromward Hammerfist

'The art of building a tunnel lies in the nature of dwarfes.' Eso es lo que solía decir mi bisabuelo. Antes que nada me gustaría haceros un pequeño repaso histórico de la construcción de túneles. .....<you skip the first 1000 pages containing dwarfen tunnelling history>.

Reparación de túneles colapsados:
Equipo: Pico, árbol o kit de albañil.
Antes de retirar los escombros es necesario colocar un contrafuerte, de lo contrario el túnel se derrumbará una y otra vez. Si no tienes un árbol a mano, aún puedes construir una pared de ladrillos para estabilizar el túnel. ¡Buena suerte!

Reparación de huecos:
Equipo: Madera, amarres de madera, martillo, clavos, herrajes de metal.
Por cada pieza que falta (sobre la base de un riel estándar) recomiendo utilizar tres piezas de madera. Asegúrelos en su posición con al menos 6 clavos. Para el riel en sí, use una sierra en un trozo de madera para construir las traviesas de madera. Luego, coloca dos herrajes metálicos sobre ellos y podrás realizar tu primer viaje en tu nuevo riel. ¡Felicidades!

Construyendo un carril sobre lava:
Te aconsejo que no lo intentes hasta que tengas al menos 20 años de experiencia en la construcción de ferrocarriles...<Well, seems like you don't match the premises.>

Aventuras en viejos túneles:
Tenga en cuenta que los de nuestra especie dominan el arte de hacer túneles. Puede que te lleve toda una vida entender las técnicas que se utilizan y se necesitan generaciones para conocer todos los túneles de una mina y todas sus salidas. Incluso puede que encuentres una salida que nunca esperabas.

para resumir
Si no eres un enano, ni siquiera intentes pensar que tienes posibilidades de dominar el arte de hacer túneles. Si eres enano te deseo mucha suerte y no abandones la fe. Hay una luz al final del túnel.

tuyo

Puño de martillo de Gromward

entries.en: You dive into an ocean of emerald light. Feeling like born anew the colour around you is almost overwhelming. Countless objects of all shapes and sizes are dashing past you. Racing against each other, millions are clashing in the distance. ..
entries.translated: Te sumerges en un océano de luz esmeralda. Sentir que naces de nuevo con el color que te rodea es casi abrumador. Innumerables objetos de todas las formas y tamaños pasan corriendo a tu lado. Compitiendo unos contra otros, millones chocan a lo lejos. ..

entries.en: The loudness of the gargantuan spectacle around you bursts your hearing, yet you absorb all the sounds around you. ...
entries.translated: El volumen del gigantesco espectáculo que te rodea explota tu oído, pero absorbes todos los sonidos que te rodean. ...

entries.en: As several large obstacles move aside directly in front of you, an intense bright centre leaps into your view. Though you cannot perceive how fast you are, your pace seems too slow. ...
entries.translated: A medida que varios obstáculos grandes se apartan directamente frente a usted, un centro brillante e intenso aparece ante su vista. Aunque no puedes percibir lo rápido que eres, tu ritmo parece demasiado lento. ...

entries.en: Ever decelerating, you ultimately approach a middle in this chaos of tones of green. ...
entries.translated: Al desacelerar constantemente, finalmente te acercas a un punto medio en este caos de tonos verdes. ...

entries.en: As you come closer to it, yellowish shades of orange embrace you, softer shapes emerge and you almost forget the mayhem before. In warm comfort you see what lies in the heart of it all. ...
entries.translated: A medida que te acercas, tonos amarillentos de naranja te abrazan, emergen formas más suaves y casi te olvidas del caos anterior. En una cálida comodidad verás lo que hay en el corazón de todo. ...

entries.en: A majestic dragon in his sleep is surrounded by what seems the warmth and energy of a thousand suns. The tranquillity of its sight makes you smile gently. ...
entries.translated: Un majestuoso dragón mientras duerme está rodeado por lo que parece el calor y la energía de mil soles. La tranquilidad de su vista te hace sonreír suavemente. ...

entries.en: You feel a perfect mixture of joy, compassion and sudden peacefulness. Bright xanthous impressions of topaz, orange and white welcome you at the final halt of your journey. ...
entries.translated: Sientes una mezcla perfecta de alegría, compasión y paz repentina. Brillantes impresiones xantosas de topacio, naranja y blanco le dan la bienvenida en la última parada de su viaje. ...
Los sueños de dragones son dorados. ...

entries.en: You are now prepared to enter the realm of the evildoer. I am grateful for your help, wayfarer. Should you seek my council, use this charm I cede to you. For my spirit will guide you wherever you are. May you enjoy a sheltered future, you shall prevail.
entries.translated: Ahora estás preparado para entrar en el reino del malhechor. Agradezco tu ayuda, caminante. Si buscas mi consejo, utiliza este hechizo que te cedo. Porque mi espíritu os guiará dondequiera que estéis. Que disfrutes de un futuro protegido, prevalecerás.

entries.en: I assume you need to get through the gate to reach the evildoer. I can help you if you trust me, wayfarer. I will share a part of my mind with you which should enable you to step through the gate. ...
entries.translated: Supongo que necesitas atravesar la puerta para llegar al malhechor. Puedo ayudarte si confías en mí, caminante. Compartiré contigo una parte de mi mente que debería permitirte cruzar la puerta. ...

entries.en: This procedure may be exhausting. Are you prepared to receive my key?
entries.translated: Este procedimiento puede resultar agotador. ¿Estás preparado para recibir mi clave?

entries.en: You return through the semi-translucent gate to the west.
entries.translated: Regresas por la puerta semitranslúcida hacia el oeste.

entries.en: You head back north to the plateau.
entries.translated: Regresas al norte hasta la meseta.

entries.en: You travel east across several large emerald bluffs and edges. All sorts of gems are scattered alongside your path.
entries.translated: Viaja hacia el este a través de varios grandes acantilados y bordes esmeralda. Todo tipo de gemas se encuentran esparcidas a lo largo de tu camino.

entries.en: You take a rather large ruby out of a pile before you.
entries.translated: Sacas un rubí bastante grande de una pila que tienes delante.

entries.en: You head north passing countless stones in the crimson sea of stones beneath your feet.
entries.translated: Te diriges hacia el norte pasando innumerables piedras en el mar carmesí de piedras bajo tus pies.

entries.en: Avoiding the bright light, you carefully put the attachment on top of the strange socket. ...

entries.en: Come, let me kiss you, darling. Oh wait, I meant kill.
entries.translated: Ven, déjame besarte, cariño. Oh, espera, quise decir matar.

entries.en: Enjoy the pain - I know you love it.
entries.translated: Disfruta el dolor, sé que te encanta.

entries.en: You won't regret you came to me, sweetheart.
entries.translated: No te arrepentirás de haber venido a mí, cariño.

entries.en: These mine is ours... you shall not pass.

entries.en: Let's battle it out in a duel!
I'll fight here in eternity and beyond.

entries.en: I am the captain of the 'Sea Goddess', the splendid and beautiful ship you see over there.
entries.translated: Jestem kapitanem 'Sea Goddess', wspaniałego i pięknego statku, który tam widzisz.

entries.en: The 'Sea Goddess' is the most beautiful in Oramond, a whole new model of ship, elegant, sure and swift. There's no weather she can't take!
entries.translated: 'Sea Goddess' jest najpiękniejszy w Oramond, zupełnie nowy model statku, elegancki, pewny i szybki. Nie ma pogody, której by nie zniosła!

entries.en: Excellent, that should be enough fish to make the bait. Tell me when ya're ready fo' the {hunt}.

entries.en: Let's go fo' a {hunt} and bring the beast down!
Dis is no passenger ship it's a WARship. I'm on hunting business.
entries.translated: Dis nie jest statkiem pasażerskim, to okręt wojenny. I'm on hunting business.

entries.en: Never heard of him. He is no captain that's for sure, otherwise I'd know him. I was on the sea for the last 20 years hunting this, this monster.
entries.translated: Nigdy o nim nie słyszałem. Na pewno nie jest kapitanem, w przeciwnym razie poznałbym go. Przez ostatnie 20 lat byłem na morzu, polując na tego potwora.

entries.en: Yee, I've been chasing that monster for over 20 years now. I promise I'll bring it down!
entries.translated: Tak, ścigam tego potwora od ponad 20 lat. Obiecuję, że to obniżę!

entries.en: I'm faithful - I'll catch that monster one day. Yes I will, as sure as my name is Captain Haba!!
entries.translated: Jestem wierny – pewnego dnia złapię tego potwora. Tak, tak, jestem pewien, że nazywam się Kapitan Haba!!

entries.en: I know Marvik in Thais. He once helped me with a furuncle I had on my ...ahh, doesn't matter. He's a nice gran'pa, though!
entries.translated: Znam Marvika w Thais. Kiedyś pomógł mi z czyrakiem, który miałam na... ach, to nie ma znaczenia. Ale to miły dziadek!

entries.en: My worst enemy is a huge sea serpent. I dunno when I started to follow it's trail. I'll kill it and if it's the last thing I'll do, I'll kill it!
entries.translated: Moim najgorszym wrogiem jest ogromny wąż morski. Nie wiem, kiedy zacząłem podążać jego śladem. Zabiję to i jeśli to będzie ostatnia rzecz, jaką zrobię, zabiję to!

entries.en: I ain't no pirate. Don't let yourself mislead by my pirate hat. I got it from a friend of mine.
entries.translated: Nie jestem piratem. Nie daj się zwieść mojemu pirackemu kapeluszowi. Dostałem to od mojego znajomego.

entries.en: Most o' my friends are dead the others don't like me anymore......well, seems there aren't many left.
entries.translated: Większość moich przyjaciół nie żyje, inni już mnie nie lubią... cóż, wygląda na to, że nie zostało ich już wielu.

entries.en: A'right, first of all you need a bait which isn't for free, though. I sell them for 50 gold each. Use the bait on the crane over there when you see something in the telescope. ...
entries.translated: Jasne, przede wszystkim potrzebujesz przynęty, która nie jest jednak darmowa. Sprzedaję je po 50 sztuk złota za sztukę. Użyj przynęty na tamtejszym dźwigu, gdy zobaczysz coś w teleskopie. ...

entries.en: Already got enough, huh? I kind o' expected that, landlubber! Let's head for Svargrond! Ready?
entries.translated: Masz już dość, co? W pewnym sensie się tego spodziewałem, szczur lądowy! Jedźmy do Svargrond! Gotowy?

entries.en: Y' already wanna give up?? I should've known. I bring ya back to Svargrond, 'kay?
entries.translated: Już chcesz się poddać? Powinienem był wiedzieć. Zabiorę cię z powrotem do Svargrond, ok?

entries.en: I'd go by myself and tear that beast's heart out if I were younger. I hope ya can do that for me. Now go and good luck to ya!
entries.translated: Gdybym był młodszy, poszedłbym sam i wyrwał serce tej bestii. Mam nadzieję, że możesz to dla mnie zrobić. A teraz idź i powodzenia!

entries.en: Ya're a coward, aren't ya? Prove that I'm wrong and get your lazy bones up to the lookout!!
entries.translated: Jesteś tchórzem, prawda? Udowodnij, że się mylę i wyprowadź swoje leniwe kości na obserwację!!

entries.en: I'm sorry but we don't serve this route.
entries.translated: Przykro mi, ale nie obsługujemy tej trasy.

entries.en: I'm sorry but we don't serve this route.

entries.translated: Pero para ello necesito un artefacto mágico: una capa hecha de plumas de cisne. Si pierdo esta capa, o alguien me la roba, quedaré atrapado en la forma de un cisne y ya no podré cambiar de forma. Y esto es exactamente lo que pasó:...

entries.en: A troll stalked me while I was bathing in the river and he stole my cloak. Now I am trapped in the form of a swan. Please, can you find the thief and bring back the cloak?
entries.translated: Un troll me acechó mientras me bañaba en el río y me robó la capa. Ahora estoy atrapado en forma de cisne. Por favor, ¿podrías encontrar al ladrón y traerle la capa?

entries.translated: Es acero ardiente. Necesito que el aliento de los verdes se derrita. O rojo aún mejor. Puedo hacerlo con escudo. ¿Alguno quiere intercambiar?

entries.en: Good good! Woman happy will be. Now me happy too and help you.
entries.translated: ¡Bien bien! La mujer será feliz. Ahora yo también estoy feliz y te ayudaré.

entries.translated: La pequeña trae tres faldas de líber.

entries.en: Lil' one bring three bast skirts?
entries.translated: ¿La pequeña trae tres faldas de líber?

entries.en: Very noble. Shiny. Me like. But breaks so fast. Me can make from shiny armour. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Muy noble. Brillante. Me gusta. Pero se rompe muy rápido. Puedo hacer con una armadura brillante. ¿Alguno quiere intercambiar?

entries.en: Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Es acero ardiente. Necesito que el aliento de los verdes se derrita. O rojo aún mejor. Puedo hacerlo con escudo. ¿Alguno quiere intercambiar?

entries.translated: Hellsteel lo es. Maldito y malvado. Peligroso para trabajar. Puedo hacer con un casco malvado. ¿Alguno quiere intercambiar?

entries.en: Good iron is. Me friends use it much for fight. Me can make from weapon. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Buen hierro lo es. Mis amigos lo usan mucho para pelear. Puedo hacerlo con un arma. ¿Alguno quiere intercambiar?

entries.en: Wait. Me work no cheap is. Do favour for me first, yes?
entries.translated: Esperar. Mi trabajo no es barato. Hazme un favor primero, ¿sí?

entries.en: Uh. Me can make some nasty lil' bolt from soul orbs. Lil' one want to trade all?
entries.translated: Oh. Puedo hacer algunos pequeños rayos desagradables con orbes del alma. ¿Un pequeño quiere cambiarlo todo?

entries.en: Cling clang! Me done good work today! Li'l one gets double bolts!
entries.translated: ¡Aferrarse sonido metálico! ¡Hice un buen trabajo hoy! ¡El pequeño recibe doble perno!

entries.en: To me, creatures of the wild!
My instincts tell me about your cowardice.
entries.translated: Mis instintos me hablan de tu cobardía.

entries.en: Mine is the power of rage!
entries.translated: ¡El mío es el poder de la ira!
¡Nunca cruces la línea de las ratas!

entries.en: IS THAT THE BEST YOU HAVE TO OFFER, TIBIANS?
entries.translated: ¿ES ESO LO MEJOR QUE TIENEN PARA OFRECER, TIBIANOS?

entries.en: I will rope you up! All of you!
Have you seen my old pal Frack?
entries.translated: ¿Has visto a mi viejo amigo Frack?

entries.en: A MIC to rule them all!
Let me put my rope around your neck!
entries.translated: ¡Déjame poner mi cuerda alrededor de tu cuello!

entries.en: A battle makes the blood so hot and sweet.
entries.translated: Una batalla hace que la sangre sea tan caliente y dulce.

entries.en: I'm Zulazza, and you won't forget me that fazzt.
entries.translated: Soy Zulazza y no me olvidarás ese fazzt.

entries.en: Oh, HE will take revenge on zzizz azzault when you zztep in front of HIZZ fazze!
entries.translated: ¡Oh, ÉL se vengará de zzizz azzault cuando te pongas delante de HIZZ fazze!

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: ¡Zzaion es nuestro último zztand! ¡No dejaré que Wizzout pelee!

entries.en: Behind zze Great Gate liezz your doom!
entries.translated: ¡Detrás de la Gran Puerta está tu perdición!

entries.en: I pray to my mazzterzz, the mighty dragonzzz!
entries.translated: ¡Rezo a mi mazzterzz, el poderoso dragonzzz!

entries.en: You are not worzzy to touch zzizz zzacred ground!
[World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!

entries.en: Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
entries.translated: Sí, sí, te mataré pronto, ahora déjame continuar mi investigación sobre ti.

entries.en: They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
entries.translated: Llorarán el día que nos abandonaron.

entries.en: It's a fine library, isn't it?
I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.
entries.translated: Soy 486486 y NO 'Blinky' como me llamaban algunas personas... antes de morir.

entries.en: Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!
Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Espera ahí mismo. Te comeré después de escribir lo que descubrí.

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Sea llorado peregrino en carne. Vendo mercadería general. Sólo pídeme un {trade}.

entries.en: Well then. Here, take the book, I added the story. Oh, just a piece of advice: Not to inflame prejudice but poachers are of rather simple disposition. I doubt they are ardent readers. ...
entries.translated: Bueno entonces. Toma, toma el libro, agregué la historia. Oh, sólo un consejo: no quiero inflamar los prejuicios, pero los cazadores furtivos son de carácter bastante simple. Dudo que sean lectores apasionados. ...

entries.en: So if you want to make sure they read this anytime soon, perhaps don't hide the book in a shelf or chest. Make sure to place it somewhere where they will find it easily, like very obviously on a table or something.
entries.translated: Entonces, si quieres asegurarte de que lean esto pronto, tal vez no escondas el libro en un estante o en un cofre. Asegúrate de colocarlo en algún lugar donde lo encuentren fácilmente, como obviamente en una mesa o algo así.

entries.en: Of course you do! Go hunt down the thieves and bring back the stuff they have stolen from me. ...
entries.translated: ¡Por supuesto que sí! Ve a cazar a los ladrones y tráeme las cosas que me han robado. ...

entries.en: I saw them running out of town and then to the north. Maybe they hide at the oasis.
entries.translated: Los vi salir corriendo de la ciudad y luego hacia el norte. Quizás se escondan en el oasis.

entries.en: What are you talking about?? I was robbed!!!! Someone catch those filthy thieves!!!!! GUARDS! ...
entries.translated: ¿¿De qué estás hablando?? ¡¡¡¡Me han robado!!!! ¡¡¡Que alguien atrape a esos asquerosos ladrones!!!!! ¡GUARDIAS! ...

entries.en: <nothing happens>....<SIGH> Like usual, they hide at the slightest sign of trouble! YOU! Want to earn some quick money?
entries.translated: <nothing happens>....<SIGH> Como de costumbre, ¡se esconden ante la menor señal de problema! ¡TÚ! ¿Quieres ganar algo de dinero rápido?

entries.en: You need some forged documents? But I will only forge something for a friend. ...
entries.translated: ¿Necesita algunos documentos falsificados? Pero sólo haré algo para un amigo. ...

entries.en: The nomads at the northern oasis killed someone dear to me. Go and kill at least one of them, then we talk about your document.
entries.translated: Los nómadas del oasis del norte mataron a alguien querido para mí. Ve y mata al menos a uno de ellos, luego hablamos de tu documento.

entries.en: The slayer of my enemies is my friend! For a mere 1000 gold I will create the documents you need. Are you interested?
entries.translated: ¡El asesino de mis enemigos es mi amigo! Por sólo 1000 de oro crearé los documentos que necesitas. ¿Estás interesado?

entries.en: I see: You want me to add an additional story to this book. A legend about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer. I could do that, yes. It costs 5000 gold, however. Are you still interested?
entries.translated: Ya veo: quieres que agregue una historia adicional a este libro. Una leyenda sobre cómo trae mala suerte matar un ciervo blanco. Podría hacer eso, sí. Sin embargo, cuesta 5000 de oro. ¿Todavía estás interesado?

entries.en: A prayer to the almighty one!
You are no match for me!
Mine is the power of the night!
entries.translated: ¡El mío es el poder de la noche!

entries.en: You can not hope to stop us all!
The power of darkness is with me!
entries.translated: ¡El poder de las tinieblas está conmigo!

entries.en: Die in the name of Science!
You will regret interrupting my studies!
entries.translated: ¡Te arrepentirás de haber interrumpido mis estudios!

entries.en: I will sing a tune at your grave.
entries.translated: Cantaré una melodía en tu tumba.

entries.en: Now your life is come to the end, hahahaha!
entries.translated: Ahora tu vida ha llegado al final, ¡jajajaja!

entries.en: Throw the soul on the altar!
Even a rat is a better mage than you!
entries.translated: ¡Incluso una rata es mejor maga que tú!

entries.en: Learn the secret of our magic! YOUR death!
entries.translated: ¡Aprende el secreto de nuestra magia! ¡TU muerte!

entries.en: Feel the power of the beast!

entries.en: Hmm. No, I don't think you have something with you that I'd like to eat. Please come back once you looted a piece of meat or a piece of ham from a rabbit or deer.
entries.translated: Hmm. Nie, nie sądzę, że masz przy sobie coś, co chciałbym zjeść. Wróć, gdy ukradniesz królikowi lub jeleniu kawałek mięsa lub szynki.

entries.en: Hello, hello! Don't be shy, I don't bite.
entries.translated: Witam, witam! Nie wstydź się, nie gryzę.

entries.en: By the way, if you want to look at old hints again, find the 'Help' button near your inventory and select 'Tutorial Hints'.
entries.translated: Przy okazji, jeśli chcesz ponownie spojrzeć na stare podpowiedzi, znajdź przycisk 'Help' w pobliżu ekwipunku i wybierz 'Tutorial Hints'.

entries.en: Alright then. Take this botanist's container and return to me once you were able to retrieve a sample. Don't lose patience!
entries.translated: W porządku. Weź pojemnik tego botanika i wróć do mnie, gdy uda ci się pobrać próbkę. Nie trać cierpliwości!

entries.en: It is hard to explain. Of course, it's not a real song as you would understand it. I don't hear it with my ears, but rather, I feel it deep inside of me. ...
entries.translated: Trudno to wyjaśnić. Oczywiście nie jest to prawdziwa piosenka, jak można by ją zrozumieć. Nie słyszę tego uszami, ale raczej czuję to głęboko w sobie. ...

entries.en: You know, we are so dependent on words that we can't think about concepts when we don't have words for them. ...
entries.translated: Wiesz, jesteśmy tak zależni od słów, że nie możemy myśleć o pojęciach, jeśli nie mamy na nie słów. ...

entries.en: Hmm, it seems that Eleonore does trust you. Perhaps she is even right. However. Since we need some help right now I guess we can't be too picky. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: 'peg leg'. She will tell you more about her problem.
entries.translated: Hmm, wygląda na to, że Eleonora ci ufa. Być może nawet ma rację. Jednakże. Ponieważ potrzebujemy teraz pomocy, nie możemy być zbyt wybredni. Wróć do Eleonory i podaj jej tajne hasło: 'peg leg'. Opowie Ci więcej o swoim problemie.

entries.en: Hey there, just to let you know - I am not a man of many words. I prefer 'deeds', you see? The poor of this city will not feed themselves. ...
entries.translated: Hej, chcę tylko powiedzieć, że nie jestem człowiekiem wielu słów. Wolę 'deeds', rozumiesz? Biedni w tym mieście nie wyżywią się sami. ...

entries.en: So in case you've got nothing better to do - and it sure looks that way judging by how long you're already loitering around in front of my nose - please help us. ...
entries.translated: Jeśli więc nie masz nic lepszego do roboty – a z pewnością tak to wygląda, sądząc po tym, jak długo już kręcisz się przed moim nosem – pomóż nam. ...

entries.en: These papers can tell us much about Carlin's plans in the North. We need you to enter 'Hellgate' and to retrieve the papers for us ...
entries.translated: Dokumenty te mogą nam wiele powiedzieć o planach Carlin na Północy. Potrzebujemy, abyś wpisał 'Hellgate' i odebrał dla nas dokumenty...

entries.en: Then don't bother me with it. I'm a busy man.
entries.translated: Więc nie zawracaj mi tym głowy. Jestem zajętym człowiekiem.

entries.en: Don't tell me I didn't warn you.
entries.translated: Nie mów mi, że cię nie ostrzegałem.

entries.en: Very good! <mumble> 'Your soul shall be protected!' Now, I need a fresh dead rat.
entries.translated: Bardzo dobry! <mumble> 'Your soul shall be protected!' Teraz potrzebuję świeżego, martwego szczura.

entries.en: Very good! <chants and dances> 'You shall face black magic without fear!' Now, I need a fresh dead black sheep.
entries.translated: Bardzo dobry! <chants and dances> 'You shall face black magic without fear!' Teraz potrzebuję świeżej, martwej czarnej owcy.

entries.en: Very good! <stomps staff on ground> 'EVIL POWERS SHALL NOT KEEP YOU ANYMORE! SO BE IT!'
entries.translated: Bardzo dobry! <stomps staff on ground> 'EVIL POWERS SHALL NOT KEEP YOU ANYMORE! SO BE IT!'

entries.en: Ten prayers for a blessed stake? Don't tell me they made you travel whole Tibia for it! Listen, child, if you bring me a wooden stake, I'll bless it for you. <chuckles>
entries.translated: Dziesięć modlitw za błogosławiony palik? Nie mów mi, że kazali ci podróżować przez to całe Tibia! Słuchaj, dziecko, jeśli przyniesiesz mi drewniany kołek, pobłogosławię go dla ciebie. <chuckles>

entries.en: Ah, the energy barrier set up by the cult is maintained by lousy magic, but it's still effective. Without a proper counterspell, you won't be able to pass it.
entries.translated: Ach, bariera energetyczna wzniesiona przez kult jest utrzymywana przez kiepską magię, ale nadal jest skuteczna. Bez odpowiedniego kontrzaklęcia nie uda Ci się go zaliczyć.

entries.en: Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
entries.translated: Nigdy nie wybieraj się na przygodę bez liny! Jeśli go nie posiadasz, wpadając przez dziurę w ziemi, nie będziesz mógł wyjść bez liny.

entries.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
entries.translated: Przykro mi, ale nie interesują mnie dobra doczesne. Jeśli chcesz coś kupić lub sprzedać, powinieneś poprosić lokalnego kupca o wymianę.

entries.en: In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
entries.translated: W sklepie Al Dee znajdziesz ważny sprzęt ogólny, taki jak {ropes}, {shovels} i latarki.

entries.en: As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
entries.translated: Como aventurero premium tienes muchas ventajas. ¡Realmente deberías echarles un vistazo!

entries.en: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
entries.translated: Si me dices el nombre de un ciudadano, te diré lo que sé sobre él o ella.

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Para ver las ofertas de un comerciante, simplemente hable con él o ella y solicite un {trade}. Con mucho gusto te mostrarán sus ofertas y también las cosas que te compran.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Aprenderá todo lo que necesita saber sobre profesiones una vez que haya alcanzado el {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: Se puede llegar a la Isla del Destino a través del {oracle} una vez que estés en el nivel 8. ¡Este viaje te ayudará a elegir tu {profession}!

entries.en: No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
entries.translated: No, gracias. Ya puedo llenar el mercado con antorchas.

entries.en: I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Vendo cañas de pescar y lombrices si quieres pescar. Simplemente pídeme un {trade}.

entries.en: Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
entries.translated: Sí, lo estoy vendiendo. Simplemente pídeme un {trade} para ver todas mis ofertas.

entries.en: He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
entries.translated: Es sólo un viejo monje. Sin embargo, puede curarte si estás gravemente herido o envenenado.

entries.en: Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!
entries.translated: ¡No te lances a la aventura sin cuerda y antorchas! ¡Compra tus insumos aquí!

entries.en: Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
entries.translated: Pobre anciana, su hijo {Tom} nunca la visita.

entries.en: He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
entries.translated: Dedicó su vida a acoger a los recién llegados a esta isla.
No tengo idea de quién es.

entries.en: Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
entries.translated: Sí, ese soy yo. ¡Es inteligente por tu parte darte cuenta de eso!

entries.en: He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
entries.translated: La mayor parte del tiempo se queda solo. Es un ermitaño fuera de la ciudad. Buena suerte para encontrarlo.

entries.en: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
entries.translated: Ella es nieta de {Obi's} y se ocupa de {armors} y {shields}. Su tienda está al suroeste de la ciudad, cerca del {temple}.

entries.en: He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
entries.translated: Vende {weapons}. Su tienda está al suroeste de la ciudad, cerca de la {temple}.

entries.en:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.

entries.en:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.

entries.en:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
entries.translated: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!

entries.en: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
entries.translated: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!

entries.en: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
entries.translated: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!

entries.en: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
entries.translated: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.

entries.en: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...
entries.translated: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...

entries.en: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.
entries.translated: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.

entries.en: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
entries.translated: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.

entries.en: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...
entries.translated: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...

entries.en: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...
entries.translated: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...

entries.en: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.
entries.translated: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.

entries.en: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...
entries.translated: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...

entries.en: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.
entries.translated: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.

entries.en: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...
entries.translated: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...

entries.en: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...
entries.translated: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...

entries.en: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.
entries.translated: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.

entries.en: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...
entries.translated: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...

entries.en: In this case I'm sorry, you may not pass this portal.
entries.translated: En este caso lo siento, no puedes pasar por este portal.

entries.en: I understand. Return to me if you change your mind, my child.
entries.translated: Entiendo. Vuelve a mí si cambias de opinión, hija mía.

entries.en: I'm sorry, I don't buy anything. My main concern right now is the bulding of this temple.
entries.translated: Lo siento, no compro nada. Mi principal preocupación en este momento es la construcción de este templo.

entries.en: Do you wish to merge your rune parts into an astral shaper rune?
entries.translated: ¿Deseas fusionar las partes de tus runas en una runa moldeadora astral?

entries.en: I'm sorry but you lack the needed rune parts.
entries.translated: Lo siento, pero te faltan las partes de runas necesarias.

entries.en: I find ways to unveil the secrets of the stars. Judging by this question, I doubt you follow my weekly publications concerning this research.
entries.translated: Encuentro formas de desvelar los secretos de las estrellas. A juzgar por esta pregunta, dudo que sigas mis publicaciones semanales sobre esta investigación.

entries.en: Do you want to repair your worn soft boots for 10000 gold coins?
entries.translated: ¿Quieres reparar tus botas blandas desgastadas por 10000 monedas de oro?

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have the item.
entries.translated: Lo sentimos, no tienes el artículo.

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough gold.
entries.translated: Lo sentimos, no tienes suficiente oro.

entries.en: So you have made it? You have really managed to steal a Tear of Daraman? ...
entries.translated: ¿Entonces lo has logrado? ¿De verdad has logrado robar una Lágrima de Daraman? ...

entries.en: To my knowledge there is only one place where you can find these gemstones - I know for a fact that the Marid have at least one of them. ...
entries.translated: Que yo sepa, sólo hay un lugar donde se pueden encontrar estas piedras preciosas; sé con certeza que los Marid tienen al menos una de ellas. ...

entries.en: Well... to cut a long story short, your mission is to sneak into Ashta'daramai and to steal it. ...
entries.translated: Bueno... para abreviar la historia, tu misión es colarte en Ashta'daramai y robarlo. ...

entries.en: Needless to say, the Marid won't be too eager to part with it. Try not to get killed until you have delivered the stone to me.
entries.translated: No hace falta decir que Marid no estará muy ansioso por desprenderse de él. Intenta que no te maten hasta que me hayas entregado la piedra.

entries.en: Needless to say, the Marid won't be too eager to part with it. Try not to get killed until you have delivered the stone to me.
entries.translated: No hace falta decir que Marid no estará muy ansioso por desprenderse de él. Intenta que no te maten hasta que me hayas entregado la piedra.

entries.en: So Baa'leal thinks you are up to do a mission for us? ...
entries.translated: ¿Entonces Baa'leal cree que estás dispuesto a cumplir una misión para nosotros? ...

entries.en: I think he is getting old, entrusting human scum such as you are with an important mission like that. ...
entries.translated: Creo que se está haciendo viejo al confiarle a escoria humana como tú una misión tan importante como esa. ...

entries.en: You can run but you can't hide
entries.translated: Puedes correr pero no puedes esconderte

entries.en: I am the king of the world!
Tigerblood is running through my veins!
entries.translated: ¡Sangre de tigre corre por mis venas!

entries.en: Your stuff will be mine soon!
I'll cut you a bloody grin!
For hurting me, my sire will kill you!
entries.translated: ¡Por hacerme daño, mi padre te matará!

entries.en: Is that the best, you can throw at me?
entries.translated: ¿Es eso lo mejor que puedes lanzarme?

entries.en: I've seen orcs tougher than you!
entries.translated: ¡He visto orcos más duros que tú!

entries.en: I hope you are enjoying your sparring Sir or Ma'am!
entries.translated: ¡Espero que esté disfrutando de su sparring, señor o señora!

entries.en: Please feel free to hit me Sir or Ma'am!
entries.translated: ¡Por favor siéntase libre de pegarme, señor o señora!

entries.en: This is your character's basic attack power whenever you enter a fight with a weapon or your fists. It does not apply to any spells you cast. The attack value is calculated from the weapon's attack value, the corresponding weapon skill, combat tactics, the bonus received from the Revelation Perks and the player's level. The value represents the average damage you would inflict on a creature which had no kind of defence or protection.
entries.translated: Jest to podstawowa siła ataku twojej postaci za każdym razem, gdy rozpoczynasz walkę bronią lub pięściami. Nie dotyczy to żadnych rzucanych przez Ciebie zaklęć. Wartość ataku jest obliczana na podstawie wartości ataku broni, odpowiednich umiejętności broni, taktyki walki, premii otrzymanej z umiejętności Revelation i poziomu gracza. Wartość reprezentuje średnie obrażenia, jakie zadasz stworzeniu, które nie ma żadnej obrony ani ochrony.

entries.en: This flat bonus is the main source of your character's power, added to most of the damage and healing values you cause.
entries.translated: Ten stały bonus jest głównym źródłem mocy twojej postaci, dodawanym do większości zadawanych przez ciebie obrażeń i wartości leczenia.

entries.en: Anyway. Are you prepared to embark on a dangerous mission for us?

Where are zhe guardz when you need zhem!

entries.en: I can't work wizh zuch dizturbancez!

entries.en: Death is too good for them.

entries.en: Looking at a nymph can blind you. Be careful, mortal being!

entries.en: Come here, sweetheart! I won't hurt you! *giggle*

entries.translated: ¡Solo estoy protegiendo la belleza de la naturaleza!

entries.en: No I don't work in the mines right now. That's my day off.
entries.translated: No, no trabajo en las minas en este momento. Ese es mi día libre.

entries.en: Nightmarish monster! This dream is not meant for you!
entries.translated: ¡Monstruo de pesadilla! ¡Este sueño no es para ti!

entries.en: You won't steal my robe! Back off!
You are not allowed to lay eyes on me in this shape!
Are you stalking me? You will bitterly regret this!
Glamour, glitter, glistering things! Do you have any of those?
entries.translated: ¡Glamour, brillo, cosas relucientes! ¿Tienes alguno de esos?

entries.en: You might be a threat! I'm sorry but I can't allow you to linger here.
entries.translated: ¡Podrías ser una amenaza! Lo siento, pero no puedo permitir que te quedes aquí.

	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.

entries.en:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.

entries.translated: Lo sentimos, no tienes suficiente dinero.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Recuerda: si estás gravemente herido o envenenado, puedo curarte gratis.

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Que tu camino sea siempre llano.

entries.en: Nature's blessing, traveller! May you not be affected by any sinister force.
entries.translated: ¡La bendición de la naturaleza, viajero! Que no te afecte ninguna fuerza siniestra.

entries.en: I heard there is a problem with a wolf mother and her whelps. However, I don't know more about it. One of my sisters, Ikassis, has taken over the body of a snake. ...
entries.translated: Escuché que hay un problema con una madre loba y sus cachorros. Sin embargo, no sé más al respecto. Una de mis hermanas, Ikassis, se ha apoderado del cuerpo de una serpiente. ...

entries.en: You succeeded! It seems the poachers have read your little faked story about killing white deer and the ensuing doom. They stopped chasing me. Thank you! ...
entries.translated: ¡Lo lograste! Parece que los cazadores furtivos han leído tu pequeña historia falsa sobre la matanza de ciervos blancos y la consiguiente perdición. Dejaron de perseguirme. ¡Gracias! ...

entries.en: You proved yourself trustworthy - at least as far as I am concerned. But as I told you I'm actually not a real animal. If you want to enter our hidden island, you must prove that you are also willing to help real animals. Would you do that?
entries.translated: Ha demostrado ser digno de confianza, al menos en lo que a mí respecta. Pero como te dije, en realidad no soy un animal real. Si quieres ingresar a nuestra isla escondida, debes demostrar que también estás dispuesto a ayudar a animales reales. ¿Harías eso?

entries.en: She knows more about the wolf. Seek her out in the north-west of Edron, near a circle of standing stones.
entries.translated: Ella sabe más sobre el lobo. Búscala en el noroeste de Edron, cerca de un círculo de piedras verticales.

entries.en: Your decision honours you. However, if you consider killing the poachers in question I ask you to halt. We, the fae, are rather peaceful beings and abhor bloodshed. Therefore, we must find another way to solve this problem. ...
entries.translated: Tu decisión te honra. Sin embargo, si piensas en matar a los cazadores furtivos en cuestión, te pido que dejes de hacerlo. Nosotros, los duendes, somos seres bastante pacíficos y aborrecemos el derramamiento de sangre. Por tanto, debemos encontrar otra forma de solucionar este problema. ...

entries.en: I already have an idea: Some birds told me that poachers are a superstitious lot. Perhaps we can get them with their own misbelief. I know that the poachers have a kind of camp north of the Green Claw Swamps. ...
entries.translated: Ya tengo una idea: algunos pájaros me dijeron que los cazadores furtivos son un grupo supersticioso. Quizás podamos atraparlos con su propia falta de fe. Sé que los cazadores furtivos tienen una especie de campamento al norte de Green Claw Swamps. ...

entries.en: Please search it out and examine it closely. Perhaps you will find something you can use against them in order to stop them from hunting white deer.
entries.translated: Búsquelo y examínelo de cerca. Quizás encuentres algo que puedas usar contra ellos para evitar que cacen ciervos blancos.

entries.en: I indeed have some troubles since I'm travelling this part of the world. When I took over the body of a white deer I wasn't aware that such an animal is a sought after quarry for hunters and poachers. ...
entries.translated: De hecho, tengo algunos problemas ya que estoy viajando por esta parte del mundo. Cuando me hice cargo del cuerpo de un ciervo blanco, no sabía que un animal así es una presa muy buscada por cazadores y cazadores furtivos. ...

entries.en: Now I'm living in the constant danger of being caught and killed. Of course, I could just take over another animal but this deer has really grown on me. I'd like to help this beautiful stag but I need your assistance. Are you willing to help me?
entries.translated: Ahora vivo en el peligro constante de que me atrapen y me maten. Por supuesto, podría encargarme de otro animal, pero este ciervo realmente me ha gustado. Me gustaría ayudar a este hermoso ciervo pero necesito tu ayuda. ¿Estás dispuesto a ayudarme?

entries.en: I'm very happy that you could help fae and animals alike. You earned our trust and may now visit our secret realm. I marked you with an arcane fae seal. Hereby you will be able to use the elemental shrines strewn about Tibia. ...
entries.translated: Estoy muy feliz de que puedas ayudar tanto a las hadas como a los animales. Te ganaste nuestra confianza y ahora puedes visitar nuestro reino secreto. Te marqué con un sello arcano de hadas. Por la presente podrás utilizar los santuarios elementales esparcidos por Tibia. ...

entries.en: There are fire, ice, energy and earth shrines. If you don't know their locations you can also reach them by most temples in this world. The elemental shrines will transport you to Feyrist now that you bear the magical seal.
entries.translated: Hay santuarios de fuego, hielo, energía y tierra. Si no conoces su ubicación, también puedes llegar a ellos desde la mayoría de los templos de este mundo. Los santuarios elementales te transportarán a Feyrist ahora que llevas el sello mágico.

entries.en: Uhmn.. Maybe Ahmet in Ankrahmun can help we to fake this book.
entries.translated: Uhmn... Quizás Ahmet en Ankrahmun pueda ayudarnos a falsificar este libro.

entries.en: The poachers are still chasing me. Please hurry and find a way to help me.
entries.translated: Los cazadores furtivos todavía me persiguen. Por favor, date prisa y encuentra una manera de ayudarme.

entries.en: You have already started this mission.

Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.
entries.translated: Fuera de nuestro {realm} secreto, mis hermanos y yo no podemos mantener nuestra verdadera forma. Si queremos viajar a otras partes del mundo, debemos apoderarnos de cuerpos de animales. Pero no les causamos ningún daño y simplemente tomamos el control si es necesario.

entries.en: Did you know... there are over 200 bones in your body to break?
entries.translated: ¿Sabías que... hay más de 200 huesos en tu cuerpo que romper?

entries.en: Did you know... a lot of so-called trivia facts aren't even remotely true?
entries.translated: ¿Sabías que... muchos de los llamados datos triviales no son ni remotamente ciertos?

entries.en: Did you know... fear can be smelled?
entries.translated: ¿Sabías que... el miedo se puede oler?

entries.en: Did you know... you could die in 1.299.223 ways within the next ten seconds?
entries.translated: ¿Sabías que... podrías morir de 1.299.223 formas en los próximos diez segundos?

entries.en: Want fairy floss? I will feed you up.
entries.translated: ¿Quieres hilo dental de hadas? Te daré de comer.

entries.en: Did you have to come here, little one? I just wanted to lay around and take it easy.
entries.translated: ¿Tenías que venir aquí, pequeña? Sólo quería descansar y tomármelo con calma.

entries.en: My little beetles, go forth, eat, feast!
Flood the room with curious energy!
Be gone, mortal! This is not your place!

entries.en:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.

entries.en: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.
entries.translated: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.

entries.en: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
entries.translated: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.

entries.en: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...

entries.en: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...

entries.en: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.

entries.en: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.

entries.en: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...

entries.en: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated:
Esta es una bendición especial que puedo otorgarte una vez que hayas obtenido al menos una de las otras bendiciones y que funciona de manera un poco diferente. ...\z
	Sólo funciona cuando otros aventureros te matan, lo que significa que al menos la mitad del daño que provocó tu muerte fue causado por otros, no por monstruos o el entorno. ...\z
	El {twist of fate} no reducirá la pena de muerte como las otras bendiciones, sino que evitará que pierdas tus otras bendiciones, así como el amuleto de la pérdida, en caso de que uses uno. Cuesta lo mismo que las otras bendiciones. ...\z
	¿Te gustaría recibir esa protección por un sacrificio de |PVPBLESSCOST| oro, niño?
