entries.en: So the leader of these... Misguided was actually controlled and not the other way round? Whatever is behind all this, that's some first-rate irony right there.
entries.translated: Entonces, ¿el líder de estos... Misguided estaba realmente controlado y no al revés? Lo que sea que esté detrás de todo esto, hay una ironía de primer nivel.

entries.en: There's a camp of outlaws to the east of Thais. Rumour has it that people are going missing but it's not linked to the bandits. ...
entries.translated: Hay un campamento de forajidos al este de Thais. Se rumorea que hay personas desaparecidas, pero no está relacionado con los bandidos. ...

entries.en: Lights have been seen at night in the abandoned ruin in the vicinity of the camp, somewhere to the south-west. Brave enough to check it out?
entries.translated: Se han visto luces por la noche en las ruinas abandonadas en las cercanías del campamento, en algún lugar al suroeste. ¿Lo suficientemente valiente como para comprobarlo?

entries.en: You have done our world a great favour and reason enough to be proud of yourself. ...
entries.translated: Le has hecho a nuestro mundo un gran favor y motivo suficiente para estar orgulloso de ti mismo. ...

entries.en: Although we could not rout out each and every cult and they will soon find another source to fuel their evil, we have dealt the enemy a vital blow that will take time and resources to recouperate from. ...
entries.translated: Aunque no pudimos derrotar a todas y cada una de las sectas y pronto encontrarán otra fuente para alimentar su maldad, le hemos dado al enemigo un golpe vital del que tomará tiempo y recursos recuperarse. ...

entries.en: You have undoubtedly bought your world some valuable time and weakened the enemy. Take my thanks in behalf of the world and keep up your heroic work. For your reward you must have two free slots. Are you ready to receive it?
entries.translated: Sin duda, le has ganado a tu mundo un tiempo valioso y has debilitado al enemigo. Reciba mi agradecimiento en nombre del mundo y continúe con su heroico trabajo. Para tu recompensa debes tener dos espacios libres. ¿Estás listo para recibirlo?

entries.en: Your actions have weakened the worldly anchors of the enemy and unveiled the source they use to strengthen their cults. ...
entries.translated: Tus acciones han debilitado las anclas mundanas del enemigo y han revelado la fuente que utilizan para fortalecer sus cultos. ...

entries.en: Our circle has used this opportunity to breach their protective shroud and aim a teleporter to this source. I would like to ask you to use it, to travel to this source and destroy it. ...
entries.translated: Nuestro círculo ha aprovechado esta oportunidad para romper su manto protector y apuntar un teletransportador a esta fuente. Me gustaría pedirles que lo utilicen, que viajen a esta fuente y la destruyan. ...

entries.en: But be warned, you will need a group twice as great compared to those with which you defeated the cults. Go now, with my blessings.
entries.translated: Pero ten en cuenta que necesitarás un grupo dos veces mayor que aquel con el que derrotaste a las sectas. Ve ahora, con mis bendiciones.

entries.en: That was no god - yet you rid the world of a being which, without the help of one, would not even have been here in the first place. Nicely done.
entries.translated: Ese no era un dios; sin embargo, liberas al mundo de un ser que, sin la ayuda de uno, ni siquiera habría estado aquí en primer lugar. Bien hecho.

entries.en: Several Edron orcs have taken to a dangerous idol it seems. It may not be too late to stop them if you act quickly. A powerful cult of orcs with a broad following could prove unsurmountable in the end. ...
entries.translated: Al parecer, varios orcos Edron se han aficionado a un ídolo peligroso. Puede que no sea demasiado tarde para detenerlos si actúa con rapidez. Un poderoso culto de orcos con un amplio número de seguidores podría resultar insuperable al final. ...

entries.en: Thanks a lot. As I already supposed the museum is just a disguise. ...
entries.translated: Muchas gracias. Como ya supuse, el museo es sólo un disfraz. ...

entries.en: You found out the true meaning. As you have described their cult object the AM on the floor might stand for "Aurea Manus". Here is your reward for your effort.
entries.translated: Descubriste el verdadero significado. Como has descrito su objeto de culto, el AM en el suelo podría significar "Aurea Manus". Aquí tienes la recompensa por tu esfuerzo.

entries.en: The alleged incentive to follow this cult is infinite prosperity. Therefore most of the worshippers are already very rich citizens of Tibia. ...
entries.translated: El supuesto incentivo para seguir este culto es la prosperidad infinita. Por lo tanto, la mayoría de los fieles ya son ciudadanos muy ricos de Tibia. ...

entries.en: This cult is abandoned in the recently opened new museum in Thais. This can be entered in the Thais exhibition. Would you like to have a look at this cult?
entries.translated: Este culto está abandonado en el nuevo museo recientemente inaugurado en Thais. Esto se puede inscribir en la exposición Thais. ¿Le gustaría echar un vistazo a este culto?

entries.en: You have already fulfilled your job to my full satisfaction. The cults are investigated and the final boss is eliminated. I have nothing more for you to do. Fare you well!
entries.translated: Ya has cumplido tu trabajo a mi entera satisfacción. Se investigan los cultos y se elimina al jefe final. No tengo nada más que hacer. ¡Que te vaya bien!

entries.en: Very nice! Come back if you have found what's going on in this cult.
entries.translated: ¡Muy lindo! Vuelve si has descubierto lo que está pasando en esta secta.

entries.en: You have not finished your work yet. Come back when you're done.
entries.translated: Aún no has terminado tu trabajo. Vuelve cuando hayas terminado.

entries.en: Here's your reward. Thank you and farewell!
entries.translated: Aquí está tu recompensa. ¡Gracias y adiós!

entries.en: The lore of the Great {Snake} is contorted like a snake. Although we feel you are touched by the snake's essence, you are not ready yet to receive the blessing of the deeper wisdom.
entries.translated: La tradición del Gran {Snake} está retorcida como una serpiente. Aunque sentimos que estás tocado por la esencia de la serpiente, aún no estás listo para recibir la bendición de la sabiduría más profunda.

entries.en: Once the powerful relics of the Great {Snake} were abundant. Most got lost to the ravages of time and our enemies. What is {left} is all the more precious.
entries.translated: Una vez las poderosas reliquias del Gran {Snake} eran abundantes. La mayoría se perdió ante los estragos del tiempo y nuestros enemigos. Lo que es {left} es aún más precioso.

entries.en: We are the guardians. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
entries.translated: Nosotros somos los guardianes. Todos somos lo que queda de la gloria del pasado.

entries.en: What you call Banuta was once a centre of our civilisation and culture. We gave those {apes} so much, but they wanted more. In the end, the Great {Snake} used them as a tool to teach our people a painful but necessary lesson.
entries.translated: Lo que llamas Banuta alguna vez fue el centro de nuestra civilización y cultura. Les dimos mucho a esos {apes}, pero querían más. Al final, el Gran {Snake} los utilizó como herramienta para enseñarle a nuestro pueblo una lección dolorosa pero necesaria.

entries.en: In their vanity our descendants thought they could use those false-born as servants. They paid a terrible price. Their downfall might only be temporary though if we can {redeem} our race in the eyes of the snake god.
entries.translated: En su vanidad, nuestros descendientes pensaron que podían utilizar a aquellos falsos nacidos como sirvientes. Pagaron un precio terrible. Sin embargo, su caída podría ser solo temporal si podemos {redeem} nuestra raza a los ojos del dios serpiente.

entries.en: Dragons are one of the greatest creations of the Great {Snake}. Yet, they are still distanced from the Great {Snake} and susceptible for {corruption} and the lies of the egg stealers.
entries.translated: Dragons son una de las mayores creaciones del Gran {Snake}. Sin embargo, todavía están distanciados del Gran {Snake} y susceptibles a {corruption} y las mentiras de los ladrones de huevos.

entries.en: You are speaking the language of animals? I'm surprised. But I'm not in the right mood for a chat.
entries.translated: ¿Estás hablando el lenguaje de los animales? Estoy sorprendido. Pero no estoy de humor para charlar.

entries.en: I didn't dare hope for it! The man told something about selling my babies to the orcs so they could train them as war wolves. ...
entries.translated: ¡No me atrevía a esperarlo! El hombre me contó algo sobre vender mis bebés a los orcos para que pudieran entrenarlos como lobos de guerra. ...

entries.en: I guess he mentioned Ulderek's Rock. Please search for them and - be they alive or not - return and tell me what happened to them.
entries.translated: Supongo que mencionó la Roca de Ulderek. Por favor, búscalos y, estén vivos o no, regresa y cuéntame qué pasó con ellos.

entries.en: I'm heartbroken, traveler. Some months ago, I was taking care of my three newborn whelps. They just opened their eyes and started exploring the wilderness as a hunter came by. ...
entries.translated: Estoy desconsolado, viajero. Hace unos meses estaba cuidando a mis tres cachorros recién nacidos. Simplemente abrieron los ojos y comenzaron a explorar el desierto cuando pasó un cazador. ...

entries.en: He shot me and took my three puppies with him. I have no idea where he brought them or whether they are still alive. This uncertainty harrows me and thus I'm unable to find peace. Will you help me?
entries.translated: Me disparó y se llevó a mis tres cachorros. No tengo idea de dónde los trajo ni si todavía están vivos. Esta incertidumbre me atormenta y por eso no puedo encontrar la paz. ¿Me ayudarás?

entries.en: I guess I will stick around for a time to watch over the grave. After this final watch I will find peace, I can feel this. Thank you, human being. You redeemed me.
entries.translated: Supongo que me quedaré un tiempo para vigilar la tumba. Después de esta última vigilia encontraré la paz, puedo sentir esto. Gracias ser humano. Tú me redimiste.

entries.en: I guess I will stick around for a time to watch over the grave. After this final watch I will find peace, I can feel this. Thank you, human being. You redeemed me.
entries.translated: Supongo que me quedaré un tiempo para vigilar la tumba. Después de esta última vigilia encontraré la paz, puedo sentir esto. Gracias ser humano. Tú me redimiste.

entries.en: Hi there! I'm ready to brief you with {tactical} advice.
entries.translated: ¡Hola! Estoy listo para informarle con {tactical} consejos.

entries.en: You will encounter quite a lot of beasties in the area ahead of us. The end of the cave-system is where the trouble begins though. The monsters here all serve some massive creature only known as Deathstrike. ...
entries.translated: Encontrarás muchas bestias en el área que tenemos delante. Sin embargo, el problema comienza al final del sistema de cuevas. Todos los monstruos aquí sirven a una criatura enorme conocida solo como Deathstrike. ...

entries.en: The creature is hidden in a well protected chamber. The good news is, we've managed to erect a crystal structure close to the cave that is able to breach its defence and teleport someone into the chamber. ...
entries.translated: La criatura está escondida en una cámara bien protegida. La buena noticia es que hemos logrado erigir una estructura de cristal cerca de la cueva que puede romper su defensa y teletransportar a alguien a la cámara. ...

entries.en: The bad new is that the crystals need a specific charge before they can work. As soon as the crystals begin to charge up, Deathstrikes' minions will frenzy and spawn in waves to crush all opposition. ...
entries.translated: La mala noticia es que los cristales necesitan una carga específica antes de poder funcionar. Tan pronto como los cristales comiencen a cargarse, los secuaces de Deathstrikes entrarán en frenesí y aparecerán en oleadas para aplastar a toda la oposición. ...

entries.en: You will have to kill them quite fast, to not be overwhelmed by their numbers! Our own tries to breach the defence has proven that you'll have to endure six waves until the teleporter to Deathtstrikes' cave opens for a short 30 seconds. ...
entries.translated: ¡Tendrás que matarlos bastante rápido para no sentirte abrumado por su número! Nuestros propios intentos de romper la defensa han demostrado que tendrás que soportar seis oleadas hasta que el teletransportador a la cueva de Deathtstrikes se abra durante unos breves 30 segundos. ...

entries.en: Use the GREEN command crystal in the cave to begin the charging of the teleport! Good luck.
entries.translated: ¡Usa el cristal de comando VERDE en la cueva para comenzar a cargar el teletransporte! Buena suerte.

entries.en: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
Thought so. You'll have to talk to the king though. The beggar king that is. The king does not grant an audience to just everyone. You know how those kings are, don't you? ...
entries.translated: അങ്ങനെ വിചാരിച്ചു. എന്തായാലും രാജാവിനോട് സംസാരിക്കണം. യാചക രാജാവ്. രാജാവ് എല്ലാവർക്കും ശ്രോതാക്കളെ അനുവദിക്കുന്നില്ല. ആ രാജാക്കന്മാർ എങ്ങനെയുള്ളവരാണെന്ന് നിങ്ങൾക്കറിയാം, അല്ലേ? ...

entries.en: However, to get an audience with the king, you'll have to help his subjects a bit. ...
entries.translated: എന്നിരുന്നാലും, രാജാവിനൊപ്പം പ്രേക്ഷകരെ ലഭിക്കാൻ, നിങ്ങൾ അവൻ്റെ പ്രജകളെ അൽപ്പം സഹായിക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്. ...

entries.en: His subjects that would be us, the poor, you know? ...
So why don't you show your dedication to the poor? Go and help Chavis at the poor house. He's collecting food for people like us. ...
entries.translated: എന്നിട്ടും പാവങ്ങളോടുള്ള നിങ്ങളുടെ സമർപ്പണം എന്തുകൊണ്ട് കാണിക്കുന്നില്ല? പാവപ്പെട്ട വീട്ടിലെ ചാവിസിനെ പോയി സഹായിക്കൂ. അവൻ ഞങ്ങളെപ്പോലുള്ള ആളുകൾക്ക് ഭക്ഷണം ശേഖരിക്കുന്നു. ...

entries.en: If you brought enough of the stuff you'll see that the king will grant you entrance in his {palace}.
entries.translated: നിങ്ങൾ ആവശ്യത്തിന് സാധനങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ടുവന്നാൽ, രാജാവ് അവൻ്റെ {palace}-ൽ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പ്രവേശനം നൽകുമെന്ന് നിങ്ങൾ കാണും.

entries.en: Hello {}, welcome to the atrium of Pumin's Domain. We require some information from you before we can let you pass. Where do you want to go?
entries.translated: ഹലോ {}, പ്യൂമിൻസ് ഡൊമെയ്‌നിൻ്റെ ആട്രിയത്തിലേക്ക് സ്വാഗതം. നിങ്ങളെ അനുവദിക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് ഞങ്ങൾക്ക് നിങ്ങളിൽ നിന്ന് കുറച്ച് വിവരങ്ങൾ ആവശ്യമാണ്. നിങ്ങൾക്ക് എവിടെ പോകണം?

entries.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
Huhu, please don't hurt me with your {}! Reason of your visit?

entries.en: How very interesting. I need to tell that to my master immediately. Please go to my colleagues and ask for Form 356. You will need it in order to proceed.
entries.translated: എത്ര രസകരമാണ്. അതെനിക്ക് ഉടനെ എൻ്റെ യജമാനനോട് പറയണം. ദയവായി എൻ്റെ സഹപ്രവർത്തകരുടെ അടുത്ത് പോയി ഫോം 356 ആവശ്യപ്പെടുക. തുടരുന്നതിന് നിങ്ങൾക്കത് ആവശ്യമാണ്.

entries.en: Oh, what a pity. Go see one of my colleagues. I give you the permission to get Form 287. Bye!
entries.translated: അയ്യോ കഷ്ടം. എൻ്റെ സഹപ്രവർത്തകരിൽ ഒരാളെ പോയി കാണുക. ഫോം 287 ലഭിക്കാൻ ഞാൻ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് അനുമതി നൽകുന്നു. ബൈ!

entries.en:
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ... \z
	It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
entries.translated:
Ах, киднаповање је тако забавно. То јест, ако нисте на страни која прима. ... \з
	Лак је новац и имате прилику да уплашите и мучите некога ко не може да узврати!

entries.en:
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ... \z
	And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ... \z
	So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
entries.translated:
Што су људи глупљи, лакше их је преварити. ... \з
	И што су сиромашнији, то им је мање значи да се освете. Хар Хар! ... \з
	Тако да се побринем да уништим оне које преварим. Онда имају друге ствари о којима треба да брину осим да ми се освете.

entries.en:
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ... \z
	If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
entries.translated:
Кључ је изгубљен у подземној реци и вероватно је до сада испливао у седам мора! ... \з
	Да тај глупи Клинац није био толико опседнут киднаповањем не би продао свој брод да купи најскупље и најкомпликованије браве за своје ћелије!

entries.en:
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ... \z
	As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
entries.translated:

entries.translated: ¡Gnometástico! Y aquí está tu fertilizante: úsalo con cuatro hongos jardineros en las cuevas. Si pierdes el fertilizante tendrás que traer el tuyo. Gnomux vende todo el equipo necesario para nuestras misiones.

entries.en: You have already started that mission.

entries.en: Gnometastic! Don't forget to step into the transformer before you go out and destroy five monster nests. If your transformation runs out, return to the transformer to get another illusion.
entries.translated: ¡Gnometástico! No olvides entrar en el transformador antes de salir y destruir cinco nidos de monstruos. Si tu transformación se agota, regresa al transformador para obtener otra ilusión.

entries.en: Thought so. You'll have to talk to the king though. The beggar king that is. The king does not grant an audience to just everyone. You know how those kings are, don't you? ...
entries.translated: คิดอย่างนั้น. แต่คุณจะต้องคุยกับกษัตริย์ ราชาขอทานนั่นเอง กษัตริย์ไม่ได้เปิดให้ทุกคนเข้าเฝ้าเท่านั้น คุณรู้ไหมว่ากษัตริย์เหล่านั้นเป็นอย่างไรใช่ไหม? ...

entries.en: However, to get an audience with the king, you'll have to help his subjects a bit. ...

entries.en: His subjects that would be us, the poor, you know? ...

entries.en: We are hiring people to fight in our so called Bigfoot company against the foes of gnomekind. Are you interested in joining?
entries.translated: Estamos contratando gente para luchar en nuestra llamada compañía Bigfoot contra los enemigos de los gnomos. ¿Estás interesado en unirte?

entries.en: Afterwards walk up to Gnomedix for your ear examination.
entries.translated: Luego camine hasta Gnomedix para su examen de oído.

entries.en: Afterwards walk up to Gnomedix for your ear examination.
entries.translated: Luego camine hasta Gnomedix para su examen de oído.

entries.en: Don't be afraid. It won't hurt! Just step in!
Oh! Hi there! I guess you are here for the {endurance} test!
entries.translated: ¡Oh! ¡Hola! ¡Supongo que estás aquí para la prueba {endurance}!

entries.en: Ah, the test is a piece of mushroomcake! Just take the teleporter over there in the south and follow the hallway. ...
entries.translated: ¡Ah, la prueba es un trozo de tarta de champiñones! Simplemente toma el teletransportador que está allí en el sur y sigue el pasillo. ...

entries.en: You'll need to run quite a bit. It is important that you don't give up! Just keep running and running and running and ... I guess you got the idea. ...
entries.translated: Necesitarás correr bastante. ¡Es importante que no te rindas! Sigue corriendo y corriendo y corriendo y... Supongo que entendiste la idea. ...

entries.en: At the end of the hallway you'll find a teleporter. Step on it and you are done! I'm sure you'll do a true gnomerun! Afterwards talk to me.
entries.translated: Al final del pasillo encontrarás un teletransportador. ¡Písalo y listo! ¡Estoy seguro de que harás un verdadero gnomerun! Después habla conmigo.

entries.en: Just take the teleporter over there to the south and follow the hallway. At the end of the hallway you'll find a teleporter. Step on it and you are done!
entries.translated: Simplemente toma el teletransportador hacia el sur y sigue el pasillo. Al final del pasillo encontrarás un teletransportador. ¡Písalo y listo!

entries.en: You have passed the test and are ready to create your soul melody. Talk to Gnomelvis in the east about it.
entries.translated: Has pasado la prueba y estás listo para crear la melodía de tu alma. Habla con Gnomelvis en el este al respecto.

entries.en: Your endurance will be tested here when the time comes. For the moment please continue with the other phases of your recruitment.
entries.translated: Tu resistencia se pondrá a prueba aquí cuando llegue el momento. Por el momento por favor continúa con las demás fases de tu contratación.

entries.en: You have passed the test. If you consider what huge feet you have to move it's quite impressive.
entries.translated: Has pasado la prueba. Si consideras los pies enormes que tienes que mover, es bastante impresionante.

entries.en: We need you to recharge our ghost pacifiers. They are placed at several strategic points in the caves around us and should be easy to find. Your mission would be to charge seven of them.
entries.translated: Necesitamos que recargues nuestros chupetes fantasma. Están ubicados en varios puntos estratégicos de las cuevas que nos rodean y deberían ser fáciles de encontrar. Tu misión sería cargar contra siete de ellos.

entries.en: On these levels we found evidence of some monumental battle that has taken place here centuries ago. We also found some grave sites, but oddly enough no clues of any form of settlement. ...
entries.translated: En estos niveles encontramos evidencia de alguna batalla monumental que tuvo lugar aquí hace siglos. También encontramos algunas tumbas, pero, curiosamente, no hay pistas de ningún tipo de asentamiento. ...

entries.en: Some evidence we have found suggests that at least one of the battles here was fought for many, many years. People came here, lived here, fought here and died here. ...
entries.translated: Alguna evidencia que hemos encontrado sugiere que al menos una de las batallas aquí se libró durante muchos, muchos años. La gente vino aquí, vivió aquí, peleó aquí y murió aquí. ...

entries.en: The battles continued until someone or something literally ploughed through the battlefields, turning everything upside down. All this killing and death soaked the area with negative energy. ...
entries.translated: Las batallas continuaron hasta que alguien o algo literalmente arrasó los campos de batalla, poniendo todo patas arriba. Todo este asesinato y muerte empapó el área con energía negativa. ...

entries.en: Necromantic forces are running wild all over the place and we are hard-pressed to drive all these undead, spirits and ghosts, away from the Spike. ...
entries.translated: Las fuerzas nigrománticas corren salvajemente por todas partes y estamos en apuros para expulsar a todos estos no-muertos, espíritus y fantasmas, lejos de Spike. ...

entries.en: Unless we can secure that area somehow, the Spike operation is threatened to become crippled by the constant attacks of the undead. ...
entries.translated: A menos que podamos asegurar esa área de alguna manera, la operación Spike corre el riesgo de quedar paralizada por los constantes ataques de los no-muertos. ...

entries.en: The whole growing downwards could come to a halt, leaving us exposed to even more attacks, counter attacks, and giving the enemy time to prepare their defences. There's a lot to do for aspiring adventurers.
entries.translated: Todo este crecimiento hacia abajo podría detenerse, dejándonos expuestos a aún más ataques, contraataques y dando tiempo al enemigo para preparar sus defensas. Hay mucho que hacer para los aspirantes a aventureros.

entries.en: Get a locksmith and free me or you will regret it, you foolish pirates!
entries.translated: Hãy kiếm một thợ khóa và giải thoát cho tôi nếu không bạn sẽ hối hận, lũ cướp biển ngu ngốc!

entries.en: I am not a princess, I am an actor!
entries.translated: Tôi không phải là công chúa, tôi là diễn viên!

entries.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
entries.translated: Vậy là bạn đã đến rồi, |PLAYERNAME|. Tôi đã hy vọng bạn sẽ không...

entries.en: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
entries.translated: CHÀO! Cái gì vậy, cái gì vậy {want}?

entries.en: Thought so. You'll have to talk to the king though. The beggar king that is. The king does not grant an audience to just everyone. You know how those kings are, don't you? ...
entries.translated: Nghĩ vậy. Tuy nhiên, bạn sẽ phải nói chuyện với nhà vua. Vua ăn xin vậy đó. Nhà vua không chỉ cho tất cả mọi người được tiếp kiến. Bạn biết những vị vua đó thế nào phải không? ...

entries.en: However, to get an audience with the king, you'll have to help his subjects a bit. ...
entries.translated: Tuy nhiên, để được diện kiến ​​nhà vua, bạn sẽ phải giúp đỡ thần dân của ông ấy một chút. ...

entries.en: His subjects that would be us, the poor, you know? ...
entries.translated: Đối tượng của anh ấy sẽ là chúng ta, những người nghèo, bạn biết không? ...

entries.en: So why don't you show your dedication to the poor? Go and help Chavis at the poor house. He's collecting food for people like us. ...
entries.translated: Vậy tại sao bạn không thể hiện sự cống hiến của mình cho người nghèo? Hãy đến giúp đỡ Chavis tại ngôi nhà nghèo. Anh ấy đang thu thập thực phẩm cho những người như chúng tôi. ...

entries.en: If you brought enough of the stuff you'll see that the king will grant you entrance in his {palace}.
entries.translated: Nếu bạn mang đủ đồ, bạn sẽ thấy rằng nhà vua sẽ cho bạn vào {palace} của ông ấy.

entries.en: Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>
entries.translated: Chết tiệt! Giữ nó xuống! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>

entries.translated: Chết tiệt! Giữ nó xuống! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>

entries.en: Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>
entries.translated: Chết tiệt! Giữ nó xuống! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>

entries.en: Hello {}, welcome to the atrium of Pumin's Domain. We require some information from you before we can let you pass. Where do you want to go?
entries.translated: Xin chào {}, chào mừng đến với sảnh của Pumin's Domain. Chúng tôi yêu cầu một số thông tin từ bạn trước khi chúng tôi có thể cho phép bạn vượt qua. Bạn muốn đi đâu?

entries.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
entries.translated: Tạm biệt và đừng quên tôi nhé!

entries.en: Huhu, please don't hurt me with your {}! Reason of your visit?
entries.translated: Huhu, xin đừng làm tổn thương tôi bằng {} của bạn! Lý do bạn ghé thăm?

entries.en: How very interesting. I need to tell that to my master immediately. Please go to my colleagues and ask for Form 356. You will need it in order to proceed.
entries.translated: Thật thú vị làm sao. Tôi cần phải nói điều đó với chủ nhân của tôi ngay lập tức. Vui lòng đến gặp đồng nghiệp của tôi và yêu cầu Mẫu 356. Bạn sẽ cần nó để tiếp tục.

entries.en: Form 411? You need Form 287 to get that! Do you have it?
entries.translated: Mẫu 411? Bạn cần Mẫu 287 để có được điều đó! Bạn có nó không?

entries.en: Form 411? You need Form 287 to get that! Do you have it?
entries.translated: Mẫu 411? Bạn cần Mẫu 287 để có được điều đó! Bạn có nó không?

entries.en: Oh, what a pity. Go see one of my colleagues. I give you the permission to get Form 287. Bye!
entries.translated: Ôi, thật đáng tiếc. Đi gặp một trong những đồng nghiệp của tôi. Tôi cho phép bạn lấy Mẫu 287. Tạm biệt!

Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>

entries.en: All our reinforcements arrive at the crystal teleporter to the east of the cave system. We need someone to navigate the new arrivals through the hazards of the dangerous caves. ...
entries.translated: Todos nuestros refuerzos llegan al teletransportador de cristal al este del sistema de cuevas. Necesitamos a alguien que guíe a los recién llegados a través de los peligros de las peligrosas cuevas. ...

entries.en: Hideous creatures and hot lava makes travelling extremely dangerous. And on top of that there is also the constant danger from falling rocks in the area. ...
entries.translated: Las horribles criaturas y la lava caliente hacen que viajar sea extremadamente peligroso. A esto se suma el peligro constante de caída de rocas en la zona. ...

entries.en: Take one from the stack here next to me and map as many structures as possible. However, we need at least three locations to make any sense of this ancient layout at all. ...
entries.translated: Tome uno de la pila que está a mi lado y mapee tantas estructuras como sea posible. Sin embargo, necesitamos al menos tres ubicaciones para darle algún sentido a este antiguo diseño. ...

entries.en: I am constantly waiting for ordnance to arrive. A lot of gnomes intend to travel out here to help us but the main access path to our base is not safe anymore. ...
entries.translated: Estoy constantemente esperando que lleguen las municiones. Muchos gnomos tienen la intención de viajar hasta aquí para ayudarnos, pero el camino de acceso principal a nuestra base ya no es seguro. ...

entries.en: Tragically we lost several gnomes after an outbreak of what I can only describe as a force from below. We were completely surprised by their onslaught and retreated to this outpost. ...
entries.translated: Trágicamente perdimos varios gnomos después de un brote de lo que sólo puedo describir como una fuerza desde abajo. Quedamos completamente sorprendidos por su ataque y nos retiramos a este puesto de avanzada. ...

entries.en: All our reinforcements arrive at the crystal teleporter to the east of the cave system. We need someone to navigate the new arrivals through the hazards of the dangerous caves. ...
entries.translated: Todos nuestros refuerzos llegan al teletransportador de cristal al este del sistema de cuevas. Necesitamos a alguien que guíe a los recién llegados a través de los peligros de las peligrosas cuevas. ...

entries.en: Hideous creatures and hot lava makes travelling extremely dangerous. And on top of that there is also the constant danger from falling rocks in the area. ...
entries.translated: Las horribles criaturas y la lava caliente hacen que viajar sea extremadamente peligroso. A esto se suma el peligro constante de caída de rocas en la zona. ...

entries.en: How fortunate! There are some trignometres lying around next to that device behind me. Take one and hold it next to high temperature heat sources. ...
entries.translated: ¡Qué suerte! Hay algunos trignometros al lado de ese dispositivo detrás de mí. Tome uno y manténgalo cerca de fuentes de calor de alta temperatura. ...

entries.en: If you gathered enough data, you will actually smell it from the device. ...
entries.translated: Si recopiló suficientes datos, los olerá desde el dispositivo. ...

entries.en: Return to me with the results afterwards. Best of luck, we count on you!
entries.translated: Vuelve conmigo con los resultados después. ¡Mucha suerte, contamos contigo!

entries.en: Excellent, you returned with more data! Let me see... hmm. ...
entries.translated: Excelente, regresaste con más datos! Déjame ver... mmm. ...

entries.en: If you manage to map one of each structure around these parts - I assume there must be at least two times as many around here - I will hand you a bonus!
entries.translated: Si logras mapear una de cada estructura alrededor de estas partes (supongo que debe haber al menos el doble por aquí), ¡te daré una bonificación!

entries.en: Well, we need more data on this but first I will have to show this to our grand horticulturist. Thank you for getting this for us!
entries.translated: Bueno, necesitamos más datos sobre esto pero primero tendré que mostrárselo a nuestro gran horticultor. ¡Gracias por conseguirnos esto!

entries.en: The heat down here is not the only problem we have but one of our greatest concerns. Not only is it almost unbearable for us, it also seems to be rising. ...
entries.translated: El calor aquí abajo no es el único problema que tenemos sino una de nuestras mayores preocupaciones. No sólo es casi insoportable para nosotros, sino que además parece estar aumentando. ...

entries.en: We need to find out if this is true and what that means for this place - and for us gnomes. You can help us do this by grabbing one of our trignometres and collecting as much as data from the heat in this area as possible. ...
entries.translated: Necesitamos descubrir si esto es cierto y qué significa para este lugar y para nosotros los gnomos. Puedes ayudarnos a hacer esto tomando uno de nuestros trignometros y recopilando la mayor cantidad posible de datos sobre el calor en esta área. ...

entries.en: We'd need at least 5 measurements. Are you willing to do this?
entries.translated: Necesitaríamos al menos 5 medidas. ¿Estás dispuesto a hacer esto?

entries.en: The heat down here is not the only problem we have but one of our greatest concerns. Not only is it almost unbearable for us, it also seems to be rising. ...
entries.translated: El calor aquí abajo no es el único problema que tenemos sino una de nuestras mayores preocupaciones. No sólo es casi insoportable para nosotros, sino que además parece estar aumentando. ...

entries.en: We need to find out if this is true and what that means for this place - and for us gnomes. You can help us do this by grabbing one of our trignometres and collecting as much as data from the heat in this area as possible. ...
entries.translated: Necesitamos descubrir si esto es cierto y qué significa para este lugar y para nosotros los gnomos. Puedes ayudarnos a hacer esto tomando uno de nuestros trignometros y recopilando la mayor cantidad posible de datos sobre el calor en esta área. ...

entries.en: <the text seems to be a mostly ruined diary of some sort, found on the body of a dead monk. Most passages make no sense at all to you>
entries.translated: <the text seems to be a mostly ruined diary of some sort, found on the body of a dead monk. Most passages make no sense at all to you>

entries.en: You have gathered the wrong spores. You ruined your collection.
entries.translated: Sie haben die falschen Sporen gesammelt. Du hast deine Sammlung ruiniert.

entries.en: You had no luck this time.
Your skill allowed you to grab a whetstone before the stone sinks into lava.
entries.translated: Deine Geschicklichkeit ermöglichte es dir, einen Schleifstein zu ergreifen, bevor der Stein in der Lava versinkt.
Warten Sie 30 Minuten, um erneut zu beginnen.

entries.en: You have already cleared this warzone in the last 20 hours. You have to wait {0} more hours.
entries.translated: Sie haben dieses Kriegsgebiet in den letzten 20 Stunden bereits geräumt. Sie müssen noch {0} Stunden warten.

entries.en: You need a mission crystal or a job done with Gnomission to enter.
entries.translated: Um teilnehmen zu können, benötigen Sie einen Missionskristall oder einen mit Gnomission erledigten Auftrag.

entries.en: You are not permitted to enter.
entries.translated: Der Zutritt ist Ihnen nicht gestattet.

entries.en: You finally have enough renown among the gnomes, ask Gnomission for a mission to receive your crystal.
entries.translated: Du hast endlich genug Ansehen bei den Gnomen erlangt, bitte Gnomission um eine Mission, um deinen Kristall zu erhalten.

entries.en: This is not the crystal you're looking for!
entries.translated: Dies ist nicht der Kristall, den Sie suchen!

entries.en: An impressive ammount of fish is stored here.
entries.translated: Hier wird eine beeindruckende Menge Fisch gelagert.

entries.en: A seemingly endless array of weapon stretches before you into the darkness.
entries.translated: Eine scheinbar endlose Auswahl an Waffen erstreckt sich vor Ihnen in die Dunkelheit.

entries.en: These barracks seem to be home for quite a lot of soldiers.
entries.translated: Diese Kaserne scheint die Heimat vieler Soldaten zu sein.

entries.en: All the players need to be level {0} or higher.
entries.translated: Alle Spieler müssen Level {0} oder höher haben.

entries.en: Congratulations! You completed %s arena, you should take your reward now.
entries.translated: Glückwunsch! Du hast %s Arena abgeschlossen, du solltest jetzt deine Belohnung erhalten.

entries.en: %s is currently in the next arena pit. Please wait until %s is done fighting.
entries.translated: %s befindet sich derzeit in der nächsten Arena-Grube. Bitte warten Sie, bis %s mit dem Kämpfen fertig ist.

entries.en: You have found {0}, but you have no room to take it.
entries.translated: Sie haben {0} gefunden, aber Sie haben keinen Platz dafür.

entries.en: You have found {0} weighing {1} oz. You have no capacity.
entries.translated: Sie haben {0} mit einem Gewicht von {1} Unzen gefunden. Sie haben keine Kapazitäten.

entries.en: You have successfully gathered the data.
entries.translated: Você coletou os dados com sucesso.

entries.en: Hm... the device reads: 0,0,zero,0,zero which may roughly translate to: NOTHING OF INTEREST HERE
entries.translated: Hm... o dispositivo lê: 0,0,zero,0,zero, o que pode ser traduzido aproximadamente como: NADA DE INTERESSE AQUI

entries.en: The device reads: 'abnormal glooth structure detected, possible probing location'
entries.translated: O dispositivo lê: 'abnormal glooth structure detected, possible probing location'

entries.en: You hold the old chestplate of Galthein in front of you. It does not fit and far too old to withstand any attack.
entries.translated: Você segura o velho peitoral de Galthein à sua frente. Não cabe e é muito antigo para resistir a qualquer ataque.

entries.en: You are not allowed to use this yet.
entries.translated: Você não tem permissão para usar isso ainda.

entries.en: seems that the mechanism still active.
entries.translated: parece que o mecanismo ainda está ativo.

entries.en: The telescope provides a perfect view over the endless ocean - no land in sight
entries.translated: O telescópio oferece uma visão perfeita do oceano sem fim – nenhuma terra à vista

entries.en: This root has already been harvested, nothing to gain here.
entries.translated: Essa raiz já foi colhida, não há nada a ganhar aqui.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Sua tentativa de colheita destruiu mais raízes suculentas do que você poderia salvar.

entries.en: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
entries.translated: Você colheu com sucesso algumas raízes suculentas.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Sua tentativa de colheita destruiu mais raízes suculentas do que você poderia salvar.

entries.en: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
entries.translated: Você colheu com sucesso algumas raízes suculentas.

entries.en: Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!
entries.translated: ¡Reuníos a mi alrededor, jóvenes caballeros! ¡Te voy a enseñar algunos hechizos!

entries.en: Beautiful Tibia. And with our help everyone is save.
entries.translated: Hermosa Tibia. Y con nuestra ayuda todos están a salvo.

entries.en: It is time to join the Knights!
entries.translated: ¡Es hora de unirse a los Caballeros!

entries.en: Knights are the warriors of Tibia. Without us, no one would be safe. Every brave and strong man or woman can join us.
entries.translated: Los caballeros son los guerreros de Tibia. Sin nosotros, nadie estaría a salvo. Todo hombre o mujer valiente y fuerte puede unirse a nosotros.

entries.en: Some day someone will make something happen to him...
entries.translated: Algún día alguien hará que le pase algo...

entries.en: A bow might be a fine weapon for someone not strong enough to wield a REAL weapon.
entries.translated: Un arco podría ser un arma excelente para alguien que no sea lo suficientemente fuerte como para empuñar un arma REAL.

entries.en: I and my students often share a cask of beer or wine at Frodo's hut.
entries.translated: Mis alumnos y yo solemos compartir un barril de cerveza o vino en la cabaña de Frodo.

entries.en: Always concerned with his profit. What a loss! He was adventuring with baxter in the old days.
entries.translated: Siempre preocupado por su beneficio. ¡Qué pérdida! Estaba de aventuras con baxter en los viejos tiempos.

entries.en: Before she became a priest she won the Miss Tibia contest three times in a row.
entries.translated: Antes de convertirse en sacerdote, ganó el concurso Miss Tibia tres veces seguidas.

entries.en: A fine game to hunt. But be careful, he cheats!
entries.translated: Un buen juego para cazar. ¡Pero cuidado, hace trampa!

entries.en: Bah, go away with these sorcerer tricks. Only cowards use tricks.
entries.translated: Bah, vete con estos trucos de brujo. Sólo los cobardes usan trucos.

entries.en: I will never understand this peaceful monks and priests.
entries.translated: Nunca entenderé a estos monjes y sacerdotes pacíficos.

entries.en: He has the muscles, but lacks the guts.
entries.translated: Tiene músculos, pero le faltan agallas.

entries.en: I am the first knight. I trained some of the greatest heroes of Tibia.
entries.translated: Soy el primer caballero. Entrené a algunos de los más grandes héroes de Tibia.

entries.en: Of course, you heard of them. Knights are the best fighters in Tibia.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, has oído hablar de ellos. Los caballeros son los mejores luchadores en Tibia.

entries.en: You are joking, eh? Of course, you know me. I am Gregor, the first knight.
entries.translated: Estás bromeando, ¿eh? Por supuesto que me conoces. Soy Gregor, el primer caballero.

entries.en: Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!
entries.translated: ¡Reuníos a mi alrededor, jóvenes caballeros! ¡Te voy a enseñar algunos hechizos!

entries.en: You have successfully gathered the data.
entries.translated: Vous avez réussi à collecter les données.

entries.en: Hm... the device reads: 0,0,zero,0,zero which may roughly translate to: NOTHING OF INTEREST HERE
entries.translated: Hm... l'appareil indique : 0,0,zéro,0,zéro, ce qui peut se traduire approximativement par : RIEN D'INTÉRÊT ICI

entries.en: The device reads: 'abnormal glooth structure detected, possible probing location'
entries.translated: L'appareil indique : 'abnormal glooth structure detected, possible probing location'

entries.en: You hold the old chestplate of Galthein in front of you. It does not fit and far too old to withstand any attack.
entries.translated: Vous tenez devant vous le vieux plastron de Galthein. Il ne rentre pas et est bien trop vieux pour résister à une quelconque attaque.

entries.en: You are not allowed to use this yet.
entries.translated: Vous n'êtes pas encore autorisé à l'utiliser.

entries.en: seems that the mechanism still active.
entries.translated: il semble que le mécanisme soit toujours actif.

entries.en: The telescope provides a perfect view over the endless ocean - no land in sight
entries.translated: Le télescope offre une vue parfaite sur l'océan sans fin - aucune terre en vue

entries.en: This root has already been harvested, nothing to gain here.
entries.translated: Cette racine a déjà été récoltée, rien à gagner ici.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Votre tentative de récolte a détruit plus de racines juteuses que vous ne pouviez en récupérer.

entries.en: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
entries.translated: Vous avez réussi à récolter des racines juteuses.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Votre tentative de récolte a détruit plus de racines juteuses que vous ne pouviez en récupérer.

entries.en: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
entries.translated: Vous avez réussi à récolter des racines juteuses.

entries.en: You need to learn this spell first

entries.translated: Nessun membro del gruppo nel raggio d'azione.

entries.en: You can't use this spell if there's a boss.
entries.translated: Non puoi usare questo incantesimo se c'è un boss.
Non ci sono mostri a distanza.

entries.en: You can't cast this spell to yourself.
entries.translated: Non puoi lanciare questo incantesimo su te stesso.
Вы не можете произнести это заклинание

entries.en: You need to learn this spell first
entries.translated: Сначала тебе нужно выучить это заклинание
В радиусе действия нет членов партии.
Вы не можете вызвать больше существ.

entries.en: You can't use this spell if there's a boss.
entries.translated: Вы не можете использовать это заклинание, если есть босс.

entries.en: You can't cast this spell to yourself.
entries.translated: Вы не можете наложить это заклинание на себя.

entries.en: Okay. Go forth and kill him.
Keep your head and focus when you confront her!
entries.translated: ¡Mantén la cabeza y concéntrate cuando la enfrentes!

entries.en: Damn walking weed-thingies! You'll find them deeper in the jungle. Weed out 150 carniphilas for our society. Alright?
entries.translated: ¡Malditos cositas andantes de marihuana! Los encontrarás en lo más profundo de la jungla. Elimina 150 carniphilas para nuestra sociedad. ¿Está bien?

entries.en: You already achieved the maximum rank for your level range. If you accept this task, you won't gain points for our society. Hunt {0} {1} and you'll be rewarded with experience and the possibility to choose a {boss}. Are you in, old chap?
entries.translated: Ya alcanzaste el rango máximo para tu rango de niveles. Si aceptas esta tarea, no ganarás puntos para nuestra sociedad. Caza {0} {1} y serás recompensado con experiencia y la posibilidad de elegir un {boss}. ¿Estás dentro, viejo amigo?

entries.en: Welcome to the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite' |PLAYERNAME|. Feel free to do {tasks} for us.
entries.translated: Bienvenido al '__PH0__' |PLAYERNAME|. Siéntete libre de hacer {tasks} por nosotros.

entries.en: Good to see you again {}. You gained {} points for our society. Ask me for {promotion} to advance your rank!
entries.translated: Qué bueno verte de nuevo {}. Ganaste {} puntos para nuestra sociedad. ¡Pídeme {promotion} para avanzar de rango!

entries.en: Such brave deed deserves a special reward! Take this holy icon. It neutralises great evil and gives you access to areas which are protected by those forces. But remember ...
entries.translated: ¡Una acción tan valiente merece una recompensa especial! Toma este ícono sagrado. Neutraliza grandes males y te da acceso a áreas protegidas por esas fuerzas. Pero recuerda...

entries.en: You may not advance in your rank anymore until you've levelled up. But you can accept tasks without getting Paw & Fur points, just for an experience reward and the possibility to fight a boss from the range lower than level 80. ...
entries.translated: No podrás avanzar más en tu rango hasta que hayas subido de nivel. Pero puedes aceptar tareas sin obtener puntos Paw & Fur, solo para obtener una recompensa de experiencia y la posibilidad de luchar contra un jefe de rango inferior al nivel 80.

entries.en: You can try {ice golems}, {quara scouts}, {mutated rats}, {ancient scarabs}, {wyverns}, {lancer beetles}, {wailing widows}, ...
entries.translated: Puedes probar {ice golems}, {quara scouts}, {mutated rats}, {ancient scarabs}, {wyverns}, {lancer beetles}, {wailing widows}, ...

entries.en: as well as {killer caimans}, {bonebeasts}, {crystal spiders} and {mutated tigers}.
entries.translated: así como {killer caimans}, {bonebeasts}, {crystal spiders} y {mutated tigers}.

entries.en: Alright, what would you like to hunt? {Ice golems}, {quara scouts}, {mutated rats}, {ancient scarabs}, {wyverns}, {lancer beetles}, ...
entries.translated: Muy bien, ¿qué te gustaría cazar? {Ice golems}, {quara scouts}, {mutated rats}, {ancient scarabs}, {wyverns}, {lancer beetles}, ...

entries.en: or {wailing widows}, {killer caimans}, {bonebeasts}, {crystal spiders} or {mutated tigers}.
entries.translated: o {wailing widows}, {killer caimans}, {bonebeasts}, {crystal spiders} o {mutated tigers}.

entries.en: You may not advance in your rank anymore until you've levelled up. But you can accept tasks without getting Paw & Fur points, just for an experience reward and the possibility to fight a boss from the range lower than level 130. ...
entries.translated: No podrás avanzar más en tu rango hasta que hayas subido de nivel. Pero puedes aceptar tareas sin obtener puntos Paw & Fur, solo para obtener una recompensa de experiencia y la posibilidad de luchar contra un jefe de rango inferior al nivel 130.

entries.en: You can try {underwater quara}, {giant spiders}, {werewolves}, {nightmares}, {hellspawns}, {high class lizards}, {stampors}, ...
entries.translated: Puedes probar {underwater quara}, {giant spiders}, {werewolves}, {nightmares}, {hellspawns}, {high class lizards}, {stampors}, ...

entries.en: as well as {brimstone bugs} and {mutated bats}.
Alright, what would you like to hunt? {Underwater quara}, {giant spiders}, {werewolves}, {nightmares}, {hellspawns}, ...
entries.translated: Muy bien, ¿qué te gustaría cazar? {Underwater quara}, {giant spiders}, {werewolves}, {nightmares}, {hellspawns}, ...

entries.en: as well as {high class lizards}, {stampors}, {brimstone bugs}, {mutated bats}.
entries.translated: así como {high class lizards}, {stampors}, {brimstone bugs}, {mutated bats}.

entries.en: This is a one-time opportunity! You won't get the holy icon twice.
entries.translated: ¡Esta es una oportunidad única! No obtendrás el ícono sagrado dos veces.

entries.en: Alright, what would you like to hunt? You can try {hydras}, {serpent spawns}, {medusae}, {behemoths}, {sea serpents}, ...
entries.translated: Muy bien, ¿qué te gustaría cazar? Puedes probar {hydras}, {serpent spawns}, {medusae}, {behemoths}, {sea serpents}, ...

entries.en: as well as {hellhounds}, {ghastly dragons}, {undead dragons}, {draken} and {destroyers}.
You gained 20 points. It's time for a promotion. You advance to the rank of a 'Ranger'. Congratulations! ...
entries.translated: Zdobyłeś 20 punktów. Nadszedł czas na promocję. Awansujesz do rangi 'Ranger'. Gratulacje! ...

entries.en: You're a lucky one. You can go and kill him without spending your 'boss points'. Have fun!
entries.translated: Jesteś szczęściarzem. Możesz iść i go zabić, nie wydając 'boss points'. Miłej zabawy!

entries.en: the {Many}, the {Noxious Spawn}, {Stonecracker}, {Gorgo}, {Kerberos}, {Ethershreck}, {Zanakeph}, {Paiz the Pauperizer}, {Bretzecutioner} and {Leviathan}.
You're lucky today. This time you'll get an experience reward and {} extra points for our societ.
entries.translated: Masz dzisiaj szczęście. Tym razem otrzymasz nagrodę w postaci doświadczenia i {} dodatkowych punktów dla naszego społeczeństwa.

entries.en: You'll find them in the surrounding of Svargrond. Hunt 300 badgers and you'll get a reward. Interested?
entries.translated: Znajdziesz je w okolicy Svargrond. Upoluj 300 borsuków, a otrzymasz nagrodę. Zainteresowany?

entries.en: They are a nuisance! You'll find them here in the jungle near the river. Hunt 300 crocodiles and you'll get a nice reward. Interested?
entries.translated: Są uciążliwe! Znajdziesz je tutaj, w dżungli, niedaleko rzeki. Upoluj 300 krokodyli, a otrzymasz niezłą nagrodę. Zainteresowany?

entries.en: Got any dwarven brown ale?? I DON'T THINK SO....and Bolfana, the tavern keeper, won't sell you anything. I'm sure about that...she doesn't like humans... I tell you what, if you get me a cask of dwarven brown ale, I allow you to enter the mine. Alright?
entries.translated: Masz jakieś krasnoludzkie brązowe piwo? NIE MYŚLĘ....a Bolfana, karczmarz, nic ci nie sprzeda. Jestem tego pewien... ona nie lubi ludzi... Mówię ci co, jeśli przyniesiesz mi beczkę krasnoludzkiego brązowego piwa, pozwolę ci wejść do kopalni. W porządku?

entries.en: HOW?....WHERE?....AHHHH, I don't mind....SLUUUUUURP....tastes a little flat but I had worse. Thank you. Just don't tell anyone that I let you in.
entries.translated: JAK?....GDZIE?....AHHHH, nie mam nic przeciwko....SLUUUUUURP....smakuje trochę mdło, ale miałem gorzej. Dziękuję. Tylko nie mów nikomu, że cię wpuściłem.

entries.en: The temple is just south west of here. Actually, it's a temple raft and the priestess is somewhat... meow... you'll see what I mean.
entries.translated: Świątynia znajduje się na południowy zachód stąd. Właściwie to tratwa świątynna, a kapłanka jest trochę... miau... zobaczysz, co mam na myśli.

entries.en: Yeah! That's it! I can't wait to give it to her! Oh - but first, I'll fulfil my promise: Here is your scimitar! Thanks again!
entries.translated: Tak! To wszystko! Nie mogę się doczekać, żeby jej to dać! Och, ale najpierw spełnię swoją obietnicę: oto twój bułat! Jeszcze raz dziękuję!

entries.en: That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
entries.translated: To zła wiadomość. Jeśli to utraciłeś, jedynym sposobem na zdobycie czegoś innego jest zabicie świętych węży. Ale nie możesz tam pójść, więc musisz zapytać poszukiwaczy przygód, którzy mogą.

entries.en: That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
entries.translated: To zła wiadomość. Jeśli to utraciłeś, jedynym sposobem na zdobycie czegoś innego jest zabicie świętych węży. Ale nie możesz tam pójść, więc musisz zapytać poszukiwaczy przygód, którzy mogą.

entries.en: Hi there, fellow adventurer. \z What's your need? Say {trade} and we'll soon get you fixed up. Or ask me about {potions}, {wands}, or {runes}.
entries.translated: Cześć, towarzyszu przygód. \z Jakie są Twoje potrzeby? Powiedz {trade}, a wkrótce Cię naprawimy. Możesz też zapytać mnie o {potions}, {wands} lub {runes}.

entries.en: I could do that, it's not far from here. I don't run a charity organisation, though. Tell you what. Give me 100 gold pieces, and me and my boat are yours for the trip. Okay?
entries.translated: Mógłbym to zrobić, to niedaleko stąd. Nie prowadzę jednak organizacji charytatywnej. Powiem ci co. Daj mi 100 sztuk złota, a ja i moja łódź będziemy twoi na czas podróży. Dobra?

entries.en: I'm sorry, human. But you need Gabel's permission to trade with me.
entries.translated: Przepraszam, człowieku. Ale żeby ze mną handlować, potrzebujesz pozwolenia Gabela.

entries.en: The druids lately claim that they are serving Crunor's will and not Uman's. Such heresy could only become possible with the independence of Carlin from the Thaian kingdom. ...
entries.translated: Druidzi twierdzą ostatnio, że służą woli Crunora, a nie Umana. Taka herezja mogła stać się możliwa dopiero po uzyskaniu niepodległości Carlin od królestwa Thais. ...

entries.en: Well, now that you've proven yourself as useful, you can ask me for another mission. Let's see if you can handle some field duty, too.
entries.translated: Cóż, skoro już udowodniłeś, że jesteś przydatny, możesz poprosić mnie o kolejną misję. Zobaczmy, czy poradzisz sobie również z niektórymi obowiązkami w terenie.

entries.en: It'll be your task to take revenge and to kill that demon. You'll find him in the depths of Edron. Good luck.
entries.translated: Twoim zadaniem będzie zemsta i zabicie tego demona. Znajdziesz go w głębinach Edron. Powodzenia.

entries.en: You're indeed a dedicated protector of the true believers. Don't stop now. Kill as many of these creatures as you can. ...
entries.translated: Rzeczywiście jesteś oddanym obrońcą prawdziwych wierzących. Nie przestawaj teraz. Zabij jak najwięcej tych stworzeń. ...

entries.en: I also have a reward for your great efforts. Talk to me about your {demon hunter outfit} anytime from now on. Afterwards, let's talk about the next mission that's awaiting you.
entries.translated: Mam też nagrodę za twoje wielkie wysiłki. Od teraz możesz w każdej chwili porozmawiać ze mną o swoim {demon hunter outfit}. Następnie porozmawiajmy o kolejnej misji, która na Ciebie czeka.

entries.en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
entries.translated: ¡Hola, |PLAYERNAME|! Bueno, así es como funciona el comercio con NPC como yo. ¡Creo que ya estás listo para cruzar el puente hacia Rookgaard! ¡Cuidarse!

entries.en: Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
entries.translated: ¡Hola de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Qué sigues haciendo aquí? ¡Deberías cruzar el puente hacia la aldea Rookgaard ahora!

entries.en: Very nice! Food for me! Sell it to me, fast! Once you sold your food to me, just say {ready} to let me know you are done.
entries.translated: ¡Muy lindo! ¡Comida para mí! ¡Véndemelo, rápido! Una vez que me hayas vendido tu comida, simplemente di {ready} para informarme que ya terminaste.

entries.en: Good bye traveller and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
entries.translated: Adiós viajero y disfruta de tu estancia en Rookgaard.

entries.en: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! As a tailor and merchant I have to say - we need to do something about your {outfit}, shall we?
entries.translated: ¡Sea saludado, |PLAYERNAME|! Como sastre y comerciante, tengo que decir: tenemos que hacer algo con respecto a su {outfit}, ¿de acuerdo?

entries.en: Hey, I thought you were going to run away, but luckily you came back. I'll show you how to change your {outfit}, okay?
entries.translated: Oye, pensé que ibas a huir, pero por suerte volviste. Te mostraré cómo cambiar tu {outfit}, ¿de acuerdo?

entries.en: Welcome back! You know, after providing my little outfit service, I like to ask a little favour of you. Can you {help} me?
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo! Sabes, después de brindarte mi pequeño servicio de outfit, me gustaría pedirte un pequeño favor. ¿Puedes {help} mí?

entries.en: Oh hey |PLAYERNAME|, you didn't answer my question yet - could you help me get some {food}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
entries.translated: Hola, |PLAYERNAME|, aún no respondiste mi pregunta. ¿Podrías ayudarme a conseguir {food}? Incluso te daré algo de oro por ello.

entries.en: Welcome to the Cassino! Here we play with: \n [PAYOUT 180%] {HIGH / LOW}: High for 4, 5, 6 and Low for 1, 2, and 3 - {ODD / EVEN }: Odd for 1, 3, 5 and Even for 2, 4 and 6 \n [PAYOUT 500%] {NUMBERS}: You choose the number, and if you get it right ... {$$$$$}
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenidos al Casino! Aquí jugamos con: \n [PAGO 180%] {HIGH / LOW}: Alto para 4, 5, 6 y Bajo para 1, 2 y 3 - {ODD / EVEN }: Impar para 1, 3, 5 y Par para 2, 4 y 6 \n [PAGO 500%] {NUMBERS}: Tú eliges el número, y si aciertas… {$$$$$}

entries.en: Always nice to meet a fellow druid, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Siempre es un placer conocer a un compañero druida, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Que Crunor te bendiga y te guíe, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Que Crunor te bendiga y te guíe, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Que Crunor te bendiga y te guíe, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ahoy. Where can I sail you today?
Ah, welcome! Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! If you need druid spells, you've come to the right place. Otherwise it's just nice to have a visitor.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido! ¡Bienvenido |PLAYERNAME|! Si necesitas hechizos de druida, has venido al lugar correcto. De lo contrario, es agradable tener una visita.

entries.en: Great Znake forgive me to converze wiz ziz unworzy blankzkin.
entries.translated: Gran Znake, perdóname por converze wiz ziz unworzy Blankzkin.

entries.en: Hey there! You don't happen to have some {food} on you, you're willing to share? Well, where are my manners, a warm welcome for now.
entries.translated: ¡Hola! ¿No tienes algo de {food} contigo, estás dispuesto a compartirlo? Bueno, ¿dónde están mis modales? Una cálida bienvenida por ahora.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Very dangerous, nasty and slimy creatures. They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta. I think a mere 800 serpent spawns should do the trick. What do you say?
entries.translated: Criaturas muy peligrosas, desagradables y viscosas. Viven en lo profundo de las antiguas ruinas de Banuta. Creo que sólo 800 engendros de serpientes deberían ser suficientes. ¿Qué dices?

entries.en: Stampors can be found in a dungeon on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 600 of them. Are you interested?
entries.translated: Los Stampors se pueden encontrar en una mazmorra en la masa continental de Zaoan. Caza 600 de ellos. ¿Estás interesado?

entries.en: They can be found all over Tibia. You'll find them in mountain caves or rocky dungeons. Hunt 200 stone golems of them and come back to me. Understood?
entries.translated: Se pueden encontrar en todo Tibia. Los encontrarás en cuevas de montaña o mazmorras rocosas. Caza 200 golems de piedra de ellos y regresa conmigo. ¿Comprendido?

entries.en: There is a veritable plague of tarantulas living in the caves north of the river to the east. Can you squish 300 tarantulas for the Hunting Elite. What do you say?
entries.translated: Hay una verdadera plaga de tarántulas que viven en las cuevas al norte del río hacia el este. ¿Puedes aplastar 300 tarántulas para Hunting Elite? ¿Qué dices?

entries.en: This particular species can be found beneath Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 terramites of them. Understood?
entries.translated: Esta especie en particular se puede encontrar debajo de Zao Steppe. Caza 300 terramitas de ellos. ¿Comprendido?

entries.en: You'll find them on the Laguna Islands. Hunt 300 thornback tortoises of them. Interested?
entries.translated: Los encontrarás en las Islas Laguna. Caza 300 tortugas espinosas de ellas. ¿Interesado?

entries.en: You are a thrill seeker? Undead dragons belong to one of the most powerful races that can be found in Tibia. Kill 400 of them. Are you in?
entries.translated: ¿Eres un buscador de emociones? Los dragones Undead pertenecen a una de las razas más poderosas que se pueden encontrar en Tibia. Mata a 400 de ellos. ¿Estás dentro?

entries.en: As you wish. Seek out a quara settlement and hunt 600 underwater quara, it doesn't matter which type you hunt. Alright?
entries.translated: Como desées. Busca un asentamiento de quara y caza 600 quara submarinas, no importa qué tipo caces. ¿Está bien?

entries.en: Wailing widow populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 400 of them. Alright?
entries.translated: Se pueden encontrar poblaciones de viudas que lloran en la masa de tierra de Zao. Caza a 400 de ellos. ¿Está bien?

entries.en: Those nasty creatures can be found on the island of Vengoth. Hunt 300 of them. Are you in?
entries.translated: Esas desagradables criaturas se pueden encontrar en la isla de Vengoth. Caza a 300 de ellos. ¿Estás dentro?

entries.en: They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 wyverns. Interested?
entries.translated: Se pueden encontrar en todo Tibia. Caza 300 wyverns. ¿Interesado?

entries.en: Nice work, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
entries.translated: Buen trabajo, viejo amigo. Si estás listo para otra misión de caza, pídeme un {task}.

entries.en: Jolly good job you did there, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
entries.translated: Muy buen trabajo el que hiciste ahí, viejo. Si estás listo para otra misión de caza, pídeme un {task}.

entries.en: Well done! If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
entries.translated: ¡Bien hecho! Si estás listo para otra misión de caza, pídeme un {task}.

entries.en: That took some time, huh? Good hunting though. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
entries.translated: Eso tomó algo de tiempo, ¿eh? Aunque buena caza. Si estás listo para otra misión de caza, pídeme un {task}.

entries.en: Happy hunting, friend! Come back to me when you are through with your task.
entries.translated: ¡Feliz caza, amigo! Vuelve a mí cuando hayas terminado con tu tarea.

entries.en: Good choice, old chap! Speak to me again when you are done hunting.
entries.translated: ¡Buena elección, viejo! Hablame de nuevo cuando termines de cazar.

entries.en: Happy hunting, friend! Come back to me when you are done hunting.
entries.translated: ¡Feliz caza, amigo! Vuelve conmigo cuando hayas terminado de cazar.

entries.en: Happy hunting, old chap! Come back to me when you are through with your task.
entries.translated: ¡Feliz caza, viejo! Vuelve a mí cuando hayas terminado con tu tarea.

entries.en: Happy hunting, old chap! Come back to me when you are done hunting.
entries.translated: ¡Feliz caza, viejo! Vuelve conmigo cuando hayas terminado de cazar.
kit de suporte para armas de lagarto
kit de support d'armes en lézard

entries.en: Welcome to Venore, |PLAYERNAME| Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Bienvenido a Venore, |PLAYERNAME| ¿Quieres información y una guía de mapas?

entries.en: Would you like me to mark locations like - for example - the depot, bank and shops on your map?
entries.translated: ¿Le gustaría que marque lugares como, por ejemplo, el depósito, el banco y las tiendas en su mapa?

entries.en: Well, nothing wrong about exploring the town on your own. Let me know if you need something!
entries.translated: Bueno, no hay nada de malo en explorar la ciudad por tu cuenta. ¡Avísame si necesitas algo!

entries.en: I can inform you about the status of this world, if you're interested.
entries.translated: Puedo informarte sobre el estado de este mundo, si estás interesado.

entries.en: Hello, is this your first visit to Venore? I can show you around a little.
entries.translated: Hola, ¿es esta tu primera visita a Venore? Puedo mostrarte un poco los alrededores.

entries.en: Talk to me if you need directions.
Need some help finding your way through Venore? Let me assist you.
entries.translated: ¿Necesita ayuda para encontrar el camino a través de Venore? Déjame ayudarte.

entries.en: Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
entries.translated: ¡Acompañamiento gratuito al depósito para los recién llegados!

entries.en: Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops - well, warehouses - spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the adventurer's guild, hunting grounds, quests and the world status.
entries.translated: Actualmente puedo contarles todo sobre la ciudad, su templo, el banco, las tiendas (bueno, los almacenes), los entrenadores de hechizos y el depósito, así como sobre el gremio de aventureros, los cotos de caza, las misiones y el estado mundial.

entries.en: The temple is pretty much in the middle of Venore. If you go south from this harbour, you can't miss it.
entries.translated: El templo está prácticamente a mitad de Venore. Si vas hacia el sur desde este puerto, no te lo puedes perder.

entries.en: The bank as well as jewel stores can be found in the House of Wealth, in the north-eastern part of Venore. I can mark it on your map if you want.
entries.translated: El banco y las joyerías se pueden encontrar en la Casa de la Riqueza, en la parte noreste de Venore. Puedo marcarlo en tu mapa si quieres.

entries.en: I can inform you about the status of this world, if you're interested.
entries.translated: Puedo informarte sobre el estado de este mundo, si estás interesado.

entries.en: Hello, is this your first visit to Venore? I can show you around a little.
entries.translated: Hola, ¿es esta tu primera visita a Venore? Puedo mostrarte un poco los alrededores.

entries.en: Talk to me if you need directions.
Need some help finding your way through Venore? Let me assist you.
entries.translated: ¿Necesita ayuda para encontrar el camino a través de Venore? Déjame ayudarte.

entries.en: Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
entries.translated: ¡Acompañamiento gratuito al depósito para los recién llegados!

entries.en: Our local bank clerk is called Ebenizer. You can find him north of the depot, near the food shop.
entries.translated: Nuestro empleado del banco local se llama Ebenizer. Puedes encontrarlo al norte del depósito, cerca de la tienda de alimentos.

entries.en: Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
entries.translated: Actualmente puedo contarles todo sobre la ciudad, su templo, el banco, las tiendas, los entrenadores de hechizos y el depósito, así como sobre el estado mundial.

entries.en: Would you like me to mark locations like - for example - the depot, bank and shops on your map?
entries.translated: ¿Le gustaría que marque lugares como, por ejemplo, el depósito, el banco y las tiendas en su mapa?

entries.en: Well, nothing wrong about exploring the town on your own. Let me know if you need something!
entries.translated: Bueno, no hay nada de malo en explorar la ciudad por tu cuenta. ¡Avísame si necesitas algo!

entries.en:
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ... \z
	All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ... \z
	Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ... \z
	We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ... \z
	I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ... \z
	That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ... \z
	He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ... \z
	So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ... \z
	He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ... \z
	Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ... \z
	As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ... \z
	The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ... \z
	When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
entries.translated:
Foi tudo ideia do capitão Kid. Veja, ele odiava seu nome e planejava se tornar conhecido pelo nome de capitão Kidnap. ...\z
	Tudo o que ele precisava era de alguém famoso para sequestrar. ...\z
	Dada a terrível falta de talento e inteligência de seus homens, isso teria sido uma grande façanha. ...\z
	Nós nos conhecíamos de alguns golpes que cometemos juntos no passado, então ele me contatou. ...\z
	Eu deveria me passar pela famosa Princesa Lumelia. Você sabe, aquele que todos procuravam. ...\z
	Isso mostraria aos seus homens e aos outros piratas que ele era um grande sequestrador. ...\z
	Ele me prometeu que eu me tornaria seu segundo em comando e levaria uma vida maravilhosa de saques, roubos e saques. ...\z
	Então concordei em me passar pela Princesa por um tempo e funcionou bem no início. ...\z
	Ele voltou comigo vestido como a princesa de um ataque sozinho e foi instantaneamente o herói do dia para seus homens. ...\z
	As coisas pioraram quando eles decidiram fazer uma festa da vitória. ...\z
	Pelo que pude perceber pelos murmúrios dos piratas, Kid perdeu a chave da minha cela enquanto fazia suas necessidades no rio subterrâneo. ...\z
	O idiota decidiu mergulhar atrás dele.. para nunca mais ser visto. ...\z
	Quando descobri sobre a morte de Kid, tentei convencer os piratas de que era uma farsa, mas eles simplesmente não acreditaram em mim!

entries.en:
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ... \z
	It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
entries.translated:
Ah, sequestro é muito divertido. Isto é, se você não estiver recebendo. ...\z
	É dinheiro fácil e você tem a chance de assustar e torturar alguém que não consegue revidar!

entries.en:
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ... \z
	If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
entries.translated:
A chave foi perdida no rio subterrâneo e provavelmente já foi levada para os sete mares! ...\z
	Se aquele garoto estúpido não estivesse tão obcecado com sequestros, não teria vendido seu navio para comprar as fechaduras mais caras e complicadas para suas celas!

entries.en:
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ... \z
	As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
entries.translated:
Enquanto nos limitarmos às cidades costeiras indefesas, poderemos fazer fortuna fácil. Har Har! ...\z
	Assim que eu sair daqui, finalmente me tornarei um capitão pirata sozinho. Eu não preciso do Capitão Kid!

entries.en: I am a MAN! Get me out you drunken fools!
entries.translated: Eu sou um HOMEM! Tirem-me daqui, seus idiotas bêbados!

entries.en: Get me out! It was all part of the plan, you fools!
entries.translated: Tire-me daqui! Tudo fazia parte do plano, seus idiotas!

entries.en: If I ever get out of here, I'll kill you all! All of you!
entries.translated: Se algum dia eu sair daqui, mato todos vocês! Todos vocês!

entries.en: I am NOT Princess Lumelia, you fools!
entries.translated: Eu NÃO sou a Princesa Lumelia, seus idiotas!

entries.en: Get a locksmith and free me or you will regret it, you foolish pirates!
entries.translated: Chame um serralheiro e me liberte ou vocês vão se arrepender, seus piratas tolos!

entries.en: I am not a princess, I am an actor!
entries.translated: Eu não sou uma princesa, sou um ator!

entries.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
entries.translated: Então você veio, |PLAYERNAME|. Eu esperava que você não...

entries.en: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
entries.translated: Oi! O que é isso, o que você {want}?

entries.en: Thought so. You'll have to talk to the king though. The beggar king that is. The king does not grant an audience to just everyone. You know how those kings are, don't you? ...
entries.translated: Pensei assim. Você terá que falar com o rei. O rei mendigo que é. O rei não concede audiência a todos. Você sabe como são esses reis, não é? ...

entries.en: However, to get an audience with the king, you'll have to help his subjects a bit. ...
entries.translated: Porém, para conseguir uma audiência com o rei, você terá que ajudar um pouco seus súditos. ...

entries.en: His subjects that would be us, the poor, you know? ...
entries.translated: Seus súditos que seríamos nós, os pobres, sabe? ...

entries.en:
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ... \z
	All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ... \z
	Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ... \z
	We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ... \z
	I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ... \z
	That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ... \z
	He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ... \z
	So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ... \z
	He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ... \z
	Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ... \z
	As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ... \z
	The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ... \z
	When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
entries.translated:
C'était l'idée du capitaine Kid. Vous voyez, il détestait son nom et envisageait de se faire connaître sous le nom de capitaine Kidnap. ...\z
	Tout ce dont il avait besoin, c'était de quelqu'un de célèbre à kidnapper. ...\z
	Compte tenu du manque lamentable de talent et d’intelligence de ses hommes, cela aurait été tout un exploit. ...\z
	Nous nous connaissions grâce à quelques escroqueries que nous avions commises ensemble dans le passé, alors il m'a contacté. ...\z
	Je devais incarner la célèbre princesse Lumelia. Vous savez, celui que tout le monde recherchait. ...\z
	Cela montrerait à ses hommes et aux autres pirates à quel point il était un grand kidnappeur. ...\z
	Il m'a promis que je deviendrais son commandant en second et que je mènerais une vie merveilleuse de pillage, de vol et de pillage. ...\z
	J’ai donc accepté de me faire passer pour la princesse pendant un moment et ça a bien fonctionné au début. ...\z
	Il est revenu avec moi habillé en princesse après un raid seul et a été instantanément le héros du jour pour ses hommes. ...\z
	Les choses ont mal tourné lorsqu'ils ont décidé d'organiser une fête de la victoire. ...\z
	D'après ce que j'ai pu comprendre d'après les marmonnements des pirates, Kid a perdu la clé de ma cellule en faisant ses besoins dans la rivière souterraine. ...\z
	L'imbécile a décidé de plonger après... pour ne plus jamais être revu. ...\z
	Quand j'ai appris la disparition de Kid, j'ai essayé de convaincre les pirates que c'était un canular, mais ils ne me croiront tout simplement pas !

entries.en:
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ... \z
	It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
entries.translated:
Ah, le kidnapping est tellement amusant. Autrement dit, si vous n’êtes pas du côté destinataire. ...\z
	C'est de l'argent facile et vous avez une chance d'effrayer et de torturer quelqu'un qui ne peut pas riposter !

entries.en:
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ... \z
	If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
entries.translated:
La clé a été perdue dans la rivière souterraine et a probablement déjà été rejetée dans les sept mers ! ...\z
	Si ce stupide Kid n'avait pas été si obsédé par les kidnappings, il n'aurait pas vendu son vaisseau pour acheter les serrures les plus chères et les plus compliquées pour ses cellules !

entries.en:
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ... \z
	As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
entries.translated:
Tant que nous restons dans les villes côtières non défendues, nous pouvons faire fortune facilement. Har Har! ...\z
	Dès que je sors d'ici, je deviendrai enfin un capitaine pirate à mon compte. Je n'ai pas besoin de Captain Kid !
